m: 1. व्य m. (√ व्ये) a coverer, MW.
2. व्य (said to be an abbreviated form of अ-व्यय) a technical symbol for indeclinables such as नि, चित्, स्वर्, &c., Vop. iii, 17.
a: व्य — A technical term for indeclinables such as नि, चित् &c.
व्यः — A cover, veil.

m: व्य्-अभिचार m. going apart or astray, deviating, not falling or fitting together, being separated or isolated, Kap.; Bhāṣāp. &c. (cf. अ-व्य्˚)
trespass, transgression, crime, vice, sin (esp. infidelity of a wife), Mn.; MBh. &c.
violation, disturbance, confusion, Mn. x, 24 &c.
change, mutation (in अ-व्य्-अभिचार mfn.), Bhag.
(in phil.) wandering from an argument, erroneous or fallacious reasoning, the presence of the हेतु (q.v.) without the साध्य (q.v.), MW.
(in gram.) deviation from or exception to a rule, irregularity, anomaly, ib.
a: व्यभि(भी)चारः — 1 Going away from, deviation, leaving the right course, following improper courses; मंत्रज्ञमव्यसनिनं व्यभिचाराविवार्जित H. 3. 16, Bg. 14. 26. --2 Transgression, violation; Ms. 10. 24. --3 Error, crime, sin. --4 Separableness. --5 Infidelity, faithlessness (of a wife or husband), unchastity; व्यभिचारात्तु भर्तुः स्त्री लोके प्राप्नोति गर्ह्यतां Ms. 5. 164; वाङ्मनः कर्मभिः पत्यौ व्यभिचारोयथा न मे R. 15. 81; Y. 1. 72. --6 An anomaly, irregularity, exception (to a rule.) --7 (In logic) A fallacious hetu, the presence of the hetu without the sādhya; हेतोः साध्याभाववद्वृत्तित्वं व्यभिचारः Tarka K.

(in phil.) from the Vyabhicāra involved in the other supposition, MW.

m: व्य्-अभिचारिन् mfn. going astray, straying or deviating or diverging from (abl.), Hariv.; Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
following bad courses, doing what is improper, profligate, wanton, unchaste (esp. said of women), faithless towards (gen.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
changeable, inconstant (opp. to स्थायिन्; cf. ˚रि-भाव above), MBh.; Sāh.; Pratāp.
(ifc.) transgressing, violating, breaking (see समय-व्य्˚)
irregular, anomalous, MW.
(a word) having a non-primitive or secondary meaning, having several meanings, ib.
व्य्-अभिचारिन् n. anything transitory (as feelings &c.), ib.
a: व्यभिचारिन् — a. 1 Straying or deviating from, going astray, erring, trespassing. --2 Irregular, anomalous. --3 Untrue, false; see अव्याभचारन्. --4 Faithless, unchaste, adulterous. --5 Profligate, wanton. --6 Departing from its usual meaning, having several secondary meanings (as a word) --m. व्यभिचारिभावः A transitory feeling. an accessory (opp. स्थायन or स्थायिभाव q. v.). (Though like the Sthāyibhāvas these accessories do not form a necessary substratum of any rasa, still they act as feeders to the prevailing sentiment, and strengthen it in various ways, whether openly or covertly. They are said to be 33 or 34 in number; for an enumeration of these, see K. P. 4 Kārikās 31-34, S. D. 169; or R. G. first Ānana; cf. विभाव and स्थायिभाव also).

m: व्य्-अभि˚चारि-ता f. the state of going apart or astray, deviation, alteration, change, variability, Śaṃk.; Bhāṣāp.
व्य्-अभि˚चारि—त्व n. the state of going apart or astray, deviation, alteration, change, variability, Śaṃk.; Bhāṣāp.
(in gram.) the having a secondary meaning or several meanings, Pāṇ., Sch.

व्य्-अभि-√ चर् P. Ā. -चरति, to act in an unfriendly way towards (acc. or gen.), sin against, offend, injure, MBh. : Kathās.; to bewitch, practise sorcery (pl. ‘against each other’), Lāṭy.; Kathās.; to come to naught, fail, Bījag.; BhP.; to go beyond, transgress, deviate from (acc.), Kir.; Pāṇ., Sch.
a: व्यभिचर् — {c1c} P. 1 To go astray, deviate from; as in अव्यभिचरित साध्यसामान्याधिकरण्यं व्यप्तिः Tarka K. --2 To transgress against, be faithless to. --3 To act crookedly. --4 To offend, injure. --5 To fail, miscarry.

m: व्य्-अभि-˚चरण n. uncertainty, doubt (see सव्यभीचरण).
व्य्-अभि-हास m. (√ हस्) derision, ridicule, Āpast.
व्य्-अभि-मान m. (√ मन्) a false apprehension or notion, erroneous view, Nyāyas.
व्य्—अभ्र mf(आ)n. cloudless, unclouded, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
व्य्-अभ्र व्य्-अम्ल. See p. 1028, col. 3.
व्य्—अभ्र—ज mfn. appearing when the sky is cloudless, VarBṛS.
व्य्—अभ्रे (ए), ind. when the sky is cloudless, ib.

व्यध् cl. 4. P. (Dhātup. xxvi, 72) विध्यति (ep. also ˚ते; pf. p. विव्याध, Br. &c.; 3. pl. विव्यधुः, MBh., विविधुः, Up.; Ā. विव्यधे, MBh.; p. विविध्वस्, RV.; aor. व्यात्सीः, Br.; Prec. विध्यात् Gr.; fut. वेद्धा, वेत्स्यति, ˚ते, MBh.; व्यद्धा, व्यत्स्यति Gr.; inf. वेद्धुम्, MBh.; -विधे, RV.; ind.p. विद्ध्वा, -विध्य, MBh.), to pierce, transfix, hit, strike, wound, RV. &c. &c. ; (with सिराम्) to open a vein, bleed, Suśr.; to pelt with (instr.), RV.; AV.; MBh.; to inflict, attach to, affect with (acc. of pers. and instr. of thing), RV.; AV.; Br.; Up.; to shake, wave, MBh.; (in astron.) to fix the position of a heavenly body, Gol.; to cling to (acc.), ŚBr. : Caus. व्याधयति or व्यधयति, (ep. also वेधयति; aor. अवीविधत् or अविव्यधत्), to pierce, open (a vein), MBh.; Suśr.; to cause to pierce or perforate, AitĀr. : Desid. विव्यत्सति, to wish to affect or taint with (instr.), ŚBr. : Intens. वेविध्यते or वाव्यद्धि (?) Gr.
a: व्यध् — {c4c} P. (विध्यति, विद्ध) 1 To pierce, hurt, strike, stab, kill; यूनां मनांसि विव्याध दृष्ट्वा दृष्ट्वा मनोभवः H. 2. 111; अक्षितारासु विव्याध द्विषतः स तनुत्रिणः Śi. 19. 99; विद्धमात्रः R. 5. 51, 9. 60, 14. 70; Bk. 5. 52, 9. 66, 15. 69. --2 To bore, perforate, pierce through. --3 To pick. --4 To wave or brandish in triumph (as the tail &c.).

m: व्यधा f. bleeding, MW.

puM, (vyaDanamiti । vyaDa tAqe + “vyaDajaporanupasarge .” 3 । 3 । 61 । ityap .) veDaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, suSrute । 1 । 3 । “sirAvyaDo DamanInAM garBiRyA vyAkftistaTA ॥”)
v: tAqane di॰ para॰ saka॰ aniw । viDyati avyAtsIt । vivyAda viviDatuH ।
pu॰ vyaDa--ac । 1 veDe amaraH BAve ap । 2 CidrIkaraRe 3 Bedane ca ।
m: व्यध m. piercing, hitting, striking, a stroke, wound, Śiś.
cutting, opening (of a vein), Suśr.
a: व्यधः — [व्यध्-अच्] 1 Piercing, splitting, hitting; Śi. 7. 24. --2 Smiting, wounding, striking. --3 Perforating. --4 A stroke, wound. --धा Bleeding.

k.v: ग्रहे ग्राहो वशः कान्तौ  रक्ष्णस्त्राणे रणः क्वणे। व्यधो वेधे पचा पाके हवो हूतौ वरो वृत्तौ॥

m: व्यधन mfn. piercing, perforating, Suśr.
व्यधन n. the act of piercing or perforating or severing (a vein), ib.
(ifc.) chase, hunting, Hcar.
व्यधिक (prob. w.r. for ह्य्-अधिक), Kām.
व्य्—अधिकर˚णाभाव m. N. of wk.
व्य्—अधिकरण mfn. being in a different case-relation, relating to another subject, KapS., Sch.; Vām.
व्य्—अधिकरण n. incongruity, Kusum.; Śiś., Sch.
the subsisting or inhering in different receptacles or subjects or substrata (sometimes applied to a loose or ambiguous argument; opp. to समानाधिक्˚ See विशेष-व्याप्ति), MW.
N. of sev. works.
व्य्-अधिकरण व्य्-अध्व &c. See p. 1028, col. 3.
a: व्यधिकरणं — Subsisting in different receptacles or substrata; (as in व्यधिकरणबहुव्रीहि which means ‘a Bahuvrīhi compound, the first member of which is not in apposition, or stands in a different caserelation, to the second, in the dissolution of the compound; e. g. चक्रपाणिः, चंद्रमौलिः &c.)

m: व्य्—अधिकरण—धर्मावच्छिन्नाभाव n. N. of wk.
व्य्—अधिकरण—धर्मावच्छिन्नाभाव-क्रोड n. N. of wk.
व्य्—अधिकरण—धर्मावच्छिन्नाभाव-परिष्कार m. N. of wk.
व्य्—अधिकरण—धर्मावच्छिन्नाभाव-प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
व्य्—अधिकरण—धर्मावच्छिन्नाभाव-रहस्य n. N. of wk.
व्य्—अधिकरण—धर्मावच्छिन्नाभाव-टीका f. N. of wk.
व्य्—अधिकरण—धर्मावच्छिन्न-वाद n. N. of wk.
व्य्—अधिकरण—पद mfn. containing words in different cases (as a Bahuvrīhi, e.g. कण्ठे-काल, ‘one who has black colour in the throat’ [= कालकण्ठ, ‘black-throated’]), Laghuk. 1036
व्य्-अधि-क्षेप m. (√ क्षिप्) invective, harsh language, MBh.

s: puM, (virudDo aDvA । prAdisamAsaH । upasargAdaDvanaH । ityac .) kutsitapaTaH । tatparyyAyaH । duraDvaH 2 vipaTaH 3 kadaDvA 4 kApaTaH 5 । ityamaraH ॥ kupaTaH 6 asatpaTaH 7 kutsisavatmaM 8 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 2 । 70 । 23 । “tUrRaM pratyAyanasvEtAn kAmaM vyaDvagatAnapi ॥”)
v: pu॰ virudDaH aDvA acsamA॰ । kupaTe amaraH ।
m: व्य्—अध्व m. half the way (व्यध्वे [AV.] or व्यध्वे [ŚBr.], in the middle of the way), KātyŚr.; MBh.
a bad road, wrong road, L.
व्य्—अध्व mf(आ)n. being in the air between the zenith and the surface of the earth, AV.
a: व्यध्वः — A bad or wrong road.

k.v: अतिपन्थाः सुपन्थाश्च सत्पथश्चार्चितेऽध्वनि। व्यध्वो दुरध्वो विपथः कदध्वा कापथः समाः॥

m: व्य्—अध्वन् mfn. being in the midst of the way (or) going astray, RV. i, 141, 7
व्य्—अध्वन् m. ‘having various paths’, N. of Agni, MW.
व्यध्वर mfn. piercing, perforating, boring (as a worm), AV. (cf. व्य्-अद्वर).

s: puM, (vyaDAya hitaH । vyaDa + yat .) DanurguRaH । yaTA, -- “vyaDyastu pratikAyaH syAjjIvAjyA BAravaM guRaH ॥”) iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
m: व्यध्य mfn. to be pierced or perforated, Suśr. (-सिर mfn. one who is to be bled, ib.)
a bowstring, L.
a butt, mark to shoot at, W.
a: व्यध्यः — A butt, target, a mark to aim at.

m: व्यध्य—सिर mfn., one who is to be bled, ib.
व्य्—अंश m. N. of a son of Vipra-citti, Hariv.; VP. (v.l. व्य्-अंस).
व्य्-अंश , व्य्-अंशक. See p. 1028, col. 2.

s: puM, (vigato'So viBAgo yasya । CedAdinA prAyo viBAgAnarhatvAdasya taTAtvam .) parvvataH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
m: व्य्—अंशक m. a mountain, W.
a: व्यंशक — a. Undressed, naked; Ki. 9. 24.

m: व्य्—अंशुक mfn. unclothed, naked, ib.
a: व्यंशुकः — A mountain.

व्यंग — a. [विगतमंगं यस्य] 1 Bodiless. --2 Wanting a limb, deformed, mutilated, maimed, crippled. --3 Illarranged. --4 Lame. --गः 1 A cripple. --2 A frog. --3 Dark spots on the cheek. --Comp. --अर्थः suggested or implied sense; cf व्यंग्य.
व्यंगयति — Den. P. To mutilate, cripple, maim.
व्यंगिता — Mutilation; Pt. 1. 201.
व्यंगुलं — An extremely small mea sure of length equal to one-sixtieth part of an angula.

व्यंग्य — a. 1 Indicated by implication, indicated by covert or indirect allusion. --2 Suggested (as sense). --ग्यं Suggested sense, insinuation, the meaning hinted at (opp. वाच्य ‘the primary or expressed meaning’, and लक्ष्य ‘the secondary or indicated meaning’); इदमुत्तममतिशयिनि व्यंग्ये वाच्याद् ध्वनिर्बुधैः कथितः K. P. 1. --Comp. --उक्तिः f. covert expression, insinuation, inuendo.
व्यंज् — {c7c} P. 1 To reveal, manifest, show; अकिंचनत्वं मखजं व्यनक्ति R. 5. 16; Śi. 1. 26. --2 To indicate, denote. --3 Ved. To anoint thoroughly. --4 Ved. To decorate, adorn.

व्यंजक — a. (जिका f.) 1 Making clear, indicating, showing, manifesting. --2 Suggesting or insinuating a meaning (as a word, opp. वाचक and लाक्षणिक q.q. v.v.). --कः 1 Dramatic action or gesture, external indication of an internal feeling by suitable gesticulation. --2 A sign, symbol. --3 Figurative expression or insinuation.
व्यंजना — 1 See व्यंजन (12) above. --2 Irony, sarcasm. --3 Insinuation. --Comp. --वृत्तिः f. insinuation, figurative or elliptical mode of expression.

व्यंजनं — 1 Making clear, indicating, manifesting. --2 A mark, token, sign. --3 A reminder; Māl. 9. --4 Disguise, garb; नानाव्यंजनाः प्रणिधयः Mu. 1; Śi. 2. 56; तपस्विव्यंजनोपेताः &c. --5 A consonant. --6 A mark of the sex, i. e. the male or female organ. --7 Insignla. --8 A mark or sign of puberty. --9 The beard. --10 A limb, member. --11 (a) A condiment, sauce, a seasoned article; N. 16. 104. (b) An article used in seasoning food, spices &c. --12 The last of the three powers of a word by virtue of which it suggests or insinuates a sense; see अंजन-ना (8) (written व्यंजना also in this sense). --13 A day. --14 A privy part. --Comp. --उदय a. followed by a consonant. --संधिः the junction or coalition of consonants.
व्यंजित — p. p. 1 Made clear, manifested, indicated. --2 Marked, distinguished, characterized. --3 Suggested, insinuated.

m: व्य्-√ अंस् P. -अंसयति, to cheat, deceive, Divyāv.
a: व्यंस् — {c10c} U. 1 To divide, distribute. --2 To foil, ward off. --3 To deceive, cheat.

m: व्य्—अंस mfn. having shoulders wide apart, broad-shouldered, MBh.
व्य्—अंस m. N. of demon vanquished by Indra, RV. (= shoulderless, Sāy.)
of a son of Vipra-citti (cf. व्य्-अंश).

s: puM, (vi + + aMsa + Rvul .) DUrttaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: pu॰ vigato'MsaH skanDo yasya kap । 1 DUrtte hemaca॰ 2 skanDaSUnye । “mayUravyaMsakAdayaSca” pARinisUtram ।
m: व्य्—अंसक m. a cheat, rogue, juggler, L.
a: व्यंसकः — A rogue, cheat; as in मयूरव्यंसकः ‘a roguish peacock’, ‘a rogue of a peacock’.

m: व्य्—अंसनीय to be cheated or deceived, W.
व्य्—अंसन n. cheating, deceiving, MBh.
a: व्यंसनं — 1 Cheating, deceiving. --2 Distributing.

m: व्य्—अंसयितव्य mfn. id., Pañcat.

s: tri, (vi + aMsa + ktaH .) pratAritaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: tri॰ vi + aMsa--kta । 1 vaYcite 2 pratArite trikA॰ ।
m: व्य्—अंसित mfn. cheated, deceived, disappointed, W.

a: व्यंतरः — A spirit, a kind of supernatural being; अस्माकं कश्चिद् व्यंतरः सिद्धः Pt. 5.

m: 1. व्य्-अङ्˚गार्थ m. (in rhet.) suggested sense or meaning, MW.
व्य्-अङ्˚गार्थ-दीपिनी f. N. of wk.
व्य्—अङ्गार mfn. without charcoal, having no fire (˚रे ind. at the time when the burning charcoal is extinguished), MBh.; MārkP.
व्य्-अङ्गार &c. See p. 1028, col. 2.
व्य्—अङ्गारे ind., at the time when the burning charcoal is extinguished
व्य्—अङ्गा˚रिन् mfn. having the charcoal extinguished, Hcat.
व्यङ्गी-√ कृ P. -क् अरोति = व्यङ्गय, MBh.; Hariv.

s: puM, (vikftAni aNgAni yasya .) BekaH । iti medinI ॥ (vikftAni aNgAni yasmAt .) muKarogaviSezaH । tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “kroDAyAsaprakupito vAyuH pittena saMyutaH । muKamAgamya sahasA maRqalaM visfjatyataH । nIrujaM tanukaM SyAvaM muKe vyaNgaM tamAdiSet ॥” iti mADavakaraH ॥ * ॥ tasya cikitsA । “vawANkurA masUrASca pralepAdbyaNganASanaH । vyaNge maYjizWayA lepaH praSasto maDuyuktayA ॥ aTavA lepanaM SastaM SaSasya ruDireRa ca । jAtIPalasya lepastu haredvyaNgaYca nIlikAm ॥ vawasya pARqupatrARi mAlatI raktacandanam । kuzWaM kAlIyakaM loDraM eBirllepaM prayojayet ॥” iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ (tri, vigataM aNgaM yasya .) hInANgaH । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 16 । 20 । “yadyenamapi mAtastvaM mAmivARqaviBedanAt । na karizyasyanaNgaM vA vyaNgaM vApi yaSasvinam ॥”)
v: na॰ vigataM vikalaM vANgaM prAdi karma॰ । 1 vikalANge vigatamaNgaM yasya । 2 aNgahIne tri॰ 3 Beke puMstrI॰ medi॰ striyAM NIz । 4 muKarogaBede tannidAnAdi mADavanidAne uktaM yaTA “kroDAyAsaprakupito vAyuH pittena saMyutaH । muKamAgamya sahasA maRqalaM visfjatyataH । nIrujaM tanukaM SyAvaM muKe vyaNgaM tamAdiSet” ।
m: व्य्—अङ्ग , see p. 1029, cols. 1, 3.
1. व्य्-अङ्ग mf(आ)n. (for 2. see col. 3) without limbs, limbless, deficient in limb, deformed, crippled, AV.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
having no wheels, BhP.
lamed, lame, MW.
bodiless, ib.
ill-arranged, ib.
व्य्-अङ्ग m. a cripple, ib.
व्य्-अङ्ग m. or n. a kind of cat's eye (a precious stone), L.
व्य्-अङ्ग (n., w.r. for त्र्य्-अङ्ग, tripartite army, MBh.)
2. व्य्-अङ्ग mfn. (for 1. see col. 1) spotted, speckled, AV.
व्य्-अङ्ग m. freckles in the face, Suśr.
a blot, blemish, stain, Hariv.
a frog, L.
steel, L.
1. व्य्-अङ्ग—ता f. deficiency of limb, crippled condition, mutilation, MBh.; VarBṛS.; Pañcat.
1. व्य्-अङ्ग—त्व n. deficiency of limb, crippled condition, mutilation, MBh.; VarBṛS.; Pañcat.
व्य्-अङ्गय Nom. P. ˚यति, to deprive of a limb, mutilate, ĀpŚr.; Pañcat.
व्यङ्गिन् mfn. deficient in limb, deformed, crippled, MBh.; MārkP.
व्य्-अङ्˚गितैकेषण mf(आ)n., defective in an eye, one-eyed, Śiś.
व्य्-अङ्˚गित mfn. mutilated (कर्णयोर् व्य्˚, perforated in the ears, MBh. [Nīlak.]; ˚तैकेषण mf(आ)n. defective in an eye, one-eyed, Śiś.)
व्य्—अङ्गुली—√ कृ P. -करोति to deprive of the fingers, MBh.
व्य्—अङ्गुल n. the 60th part of an Aṅgula, MW.
व्य्—अङ्गुष्ठ a kind of plant, L. (w.r. for काङ्गुष्ठ).
व्य्-अङ्˚ग्यार्थ-दीपिका f. N. of wk.
व्य्-अङ्˚ग्यार्थ-कौमुदी f. N. of wk.

s: tri, vyaYjanayA boDyo'rTaH । yaTA, -- “vAcyo'rTo'BiDayA boDyo lakzyo lakzaRayA mataH । vyaNgyo vyaYjanayA tAH syustisraH Sabdasya SaktayaH ॥” iti sAhityadarpaRe 2 paricCedaH ॥
v: tri॰ vi + anja--Ryat । 1 vyaYjanayA vfttyA boDye'rTe “vAcyo'rTo'BiDayA boDyo lakzyo lakzaRayA mataH । vyaNgyo vyaYjanayA tAH syustisraH Sabdasya SaktayaH” sA॰ da॰ । 2 prakASye ca ।
m: व्य्-अङ्ग्य &c. See col. 3.
व्य्-अङ्ग्य mf(आ)n. that which is manifested or indicated or made perceptible, Śaṃk.; Sāh.
(in rhet.) indicated by allusion or insinuation, implied, suggestive, Kpr.
व्य्-अङ्˚ग्योक्ति f. covert language or insinuation, MW.
व्यङ्कट older form of वेङ्कट.
व्य्—अङ्कुश mfn. unrestrained, unchecked, BhP.
व्य्-अङ्कुश See p. 1028, col. 2.

व्य्-√ अश् P. Ā. -अश्नोति, -अश्नुते, to reach, attain, Bhaṭṭ.; to obtain, take possession of RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.; to fall to one's share, RV.; AV.; to pervade, interpenetrate, fill, occupy, Ragh.; Bhaṭṭ.
व्य्-√ अश् P. Ā. -अश्नाति, -अश्नीते, to eat up, consume by eating, RV.; AV.
a: व्यश् — {c5c} A. 1 To fill completely, pervade, occupy; प्रतापस्तस्य भानोश्च युगपद् व्यानशे दिशः R. 4. 15; Bk. 9. 4; 14. 96. --2 To obtain, attain to, reach. --3 To possess, gain. --4 To fall to one's share.

m: 1. व्य्—अशन mf(आ)n. (for 2. See p. 1034, col. 3) abstinence from eating, fasting, Hariv.
2. व्य्-अशन m. (for 1. See p. 1028, col. 3), Kāṭh. (a word used in a partic. formula; other forms are वैयशन; व्य्-अश्निय, TS.; व्य्-अश्नुविन्, VS.)
व्य्—अश्व mfn. deprived of horses, horseless, ṢaḍvBr.; MBh.; Ragh.
व्य्—अश्व m. N. of a Ṛṣi, RV.
of an ancient king (also pl.), ib.; MBh.
व्य्-अश्व &c. See p. 1028, col. 3.
व्य्—अश्व—सारथ्य्-आयुध mfn. deprived of horses and charioteer and weapons, Gaut.
व्य्—अश्व—वत् ind. like Vyaśva, MW.

व्यथ् cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xix, 2) व्यथते (ep. also ˚ति; pf. विव्यथे, 3. pl. ˚थुः, MBh.; aor. व्यथिषि, AV.; Subj. व्यथिषत्, Br.; fut. व्यथिता, ˚थिष्यते Gr.; inf. व्यथितुम्, ib., Ved. inf. व्यथिष्यै), to tremble, waver, go astray, come to naught, fail, RV. &c. &c. (with abl. = to be deprived of, lose; with चरित्र-तस्, to abandon the path of virtue); to fall (on the ground), Mn. vii, 84 (‘to be dried up’, Kull.); to cease, become ineffective (as poison), Kām.; to be agitated or disturbed in mind, be restless or sorrowful or unhappy, AV. &c. &c.; to be afraid of (gen.), R. Caus. व्यथयति (aor. विव्यथस्, Br.; व्यथयीस्, AV.), to cause to tremble or fall, RV. &c. &c.; to cause to swerve from (abl.), Bhaṭṭ.; to disquiet, frighten, agitate, pain, afflict, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Pass. of Caus. व्यथ्यते, to be set in restless motion, Suśr. : Desid. विव्यथिषते Gr.: Intens. वाव्यथ्यते, वाव्यत्ति, ib.
a: व्यथ् — {c1c} A. (व्यथते, व्यथित) 1 To be sorry, to be pained, vexed or afflicted, be agitated or disquieted; विश्वंभरापि नाम व्यथते इति जितमपत्यस्नेहेन U. 7; न विव्यथे तस्य मनः Ki. 1. 2, 24. --2 To be disturbed, be ruffled or agitated; व्यथितसिंधुमनीरशनैः शनैः Ki. 5. 11. --3 To tremble. --4 To be afraid. --5 To dry, become dry. --Caus. (व्यथयति-ते) 1 To pain, distress, vex, annoy; U. 1. 28. --2 To frustrate, mar. --3 To frighten, terrify. --4 To lead or turn away. --WITH प्र to be excessively vexed; Bg. 11. 20.

s: strI, (vyaTa + aN । wAp .) duHKam । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, uttaracarite । 1 । “snehaM dayAM taTA sOKyaM yadi vA jAnakImapi । ArADanAya lokAnAM muYcato nAsti me vyaTA ॥”)
v: strI vyaTa--BAve aN । 1 pIqAyAm 2 duHKe ca amaraH ।
m: व्यथा f. agitation, perturbation, alarm, uneasiness, pain, anguish, fear, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (व्यथां-√ कृ, either, ‘to cause pain’ or ‘to feel pain’)
loss, damage, ill-luck, ŚBr.; VarBṛS.
(with हृदि or हृदये), palpitation, throbbing of the heart, Suśr.
a: व्यथा — [व्यथ्-भावे-अङ्] 1 Pain, agony, anguish; तां च व्यथां प्रसवकालकृतामवाप्य U. 4. 23, 1. 12. --2 Fear, alarm, anxiety: स्वंतमित्यलघयत्स तद्व्यथां R. 11. 62. --3 Agitation, disquietude. --4 Disease. --Comp. --कर a. painful, troublesome, hurtful.

k.v: विष्टिराजूः कारणा तु यातना तीव्रवेदना। पीडा बाधा व्यथा दुःखमामनस्यं प्रसूतिजम्.। स्यात्कष्टं कृच्छ्रमाभीलं त्रिष्वेषां भेद्यगामि यत्.।

m: व्यथा—कर mfn. causing pain (bodily or mental), painful, excruciating, W.

Ā.) to cause to appear, manifest, display, RV. &c. &c.: Pass. -अज्यते, to be manifested or expressed, RV.; Ragh.; Pañcat. : Caus. -अञ्जयति, to cause to appear, make clearly visible or manifest, Mn.; MBh. &c.

s: strI, (vi + aYja + Ric + yuc । wAp .) Sabdasya vfttiviSezaH । tasyA lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “viratAsvaBiDAdyAsu yayArTo boDyate'paraH । sA vfttirvyaYjanA nAma SabdasyArTAdikasya ca ॥” SabdabudDikarmmaRAM viramya vyApArABAva iti nayenABiDA lakzaRA tAtparyyAKyAsu tisfzu vfttizu svaM svamarTaM boDayitvA upakzIRAsu yayAnyo'rTo boDyate sA SabdasyArTasya prakftipratyayAdeSca vfttirvyaYjana-Dvanana-gamana-pratyAyanAdivyapadeSavizayA vyaYjanA nAma । tatra । “aBiDAlakzaRAmUlA Sabdasya vyaYjanA dbiDA ॥” aBiDAmUlAmAha । “anekArTasya Sabdasya saMyogAdyErniyantrite । ekatrArTe'nyaDIheturvyaYjanA sABiDASrayA ॥” AdiSabdAdviprayogAdayaH । uktaM hi । “saMyogo viprayogaSca sAhacaryyaM viroDitA । arTaH prakaraRaM liNgaM SabdasyAnyasya sanniDiH ॥ sAmarTyamOcitI deSaH kAlo vyaktiH svarAdayaH । SabdArTasyAnavacCede viSezasmftihetavaH ॥” iti ॥ saSaNKacakro harirityatra SaNKacakrasaMyogena hariSabdo vizRumevABiDatte । aSaNKacakro haririti tadbiyogena tameva । BImArjjunAviti arjjunaH pArTaH । karRArjjunAviti karRaH sUtaputtraH । sTARuM vande BavacCide iti sTARuH SivaH । sarvvaM jAnAti deva iti devo BavAn । kupito makaraDvajaH iti makaraDvajaH kAmaH । devaH purAririti purAriH SivaH । maDunA mattaH pika iti maDurvasantaH । pAtu vo dayitAmuKamiti muKaM sAMmuKyam । viBAti gagane candraH iti candraH SaSI । niSi citraBAnuriti citraBAnurvahriH । BAti raTANgamiti napuMsakavyaktyA raTANgaM cakram । svarastu veda eva viSezapratItikfnna kAvya iti tasya vizaye nodAhftam । idaYca ke'pyasahamAnA AhuH svaro'pi kAkkAdirUpaH kAvye viSezapratItikfdeva । udAttAdirUpo'pi muneH pAWoktadiSA SfNgArAdirasaviSezapratItikfdeveti । etadvizaye udAharaRamucitameva iti tanna taTAhi svarAH kAkkAdaya udAttAdayo vA vyaNgyarUpameva viSezaM pratyAyayanti na Kalu prakftoktamanekArTaSabdasyEkArTaniyantraRarUpaM viSezam । kiYca yadi yatra kvacidanekArTaSabdAnAM prakaraRAdiniyamABAvAdaniyantritayorapyarTayoranurUpasvaravaSenEkatra niyamanaM vAcyaM tadA taTAviDasTale SlezAnaNgIkAraprasaNgaH na ca taTA ataevAhuH SlezanirUpaRaprastAve kAvyamArge svaro na gaRyate iti ca naya ityalamupajIvyAnAM mAnyAnA vyAKyAnezu kawAkzanikzepeRa । AdiSabdAdetAvanmAtrastanItyAdO hastAdicezwAdiBiH stanAdInAM kamalakorakAdyAkAratvam । evamekasminnarTe'BiDayA niyantrite yA SabdasyAnyArTabudDihetuH SaktiH sA aBiDAmUlA vyaYjanA । yaTA mama tAtapAdAnAM mahApAtracaturddaSaBAzAvAravilAsinIBujaNgamahAkavISvaraSrIcandraSeKarasAnDivigrahikARAm । “durgAlaNGitavigraho manasijaM saMmIlayaMstejasA prodyadrAjakalo gfhItagarimA viSvagvfto BogiBiH । nakzatreSakftekzaRo girigurO gAQAM ruciM DArayan । gAmAkramya viBUtiBUzitatanUrAjatyumAvallaBaH ॥” atra prakaraRenABiDayA umAvallaBaSabdasya umAnAmnI mahAdevI tadvallaBaBAnudevanfpatirUpe'rTe niyantrite vyaYjanayEva gOrIvallaBarUpo'rTo boDyate । evamanyat ॥ * ॥ lakzaRAmUlAmAha । “lakzaRopAsyate yasya kfte tattu prayojanam । yayA pratyAyyate sA syAdvyaYjanA lakzaRASrayA ॥” gaNgAyAM Goza ityAdO jalamayAdyarTaboDanAdaBiDAyAM viratAyAM tawAdyarTaboDanAcca lakzaRAyAM viratAyAM yayA SItatvapAvanatvAdyatiSayAdirboDyate sA lakzaRAmUlA vyaYjanA ॥ * ॥ evaM SAbdIM vyaYjanAmuktvA ArTIM vyaYjanAmAha । “vaktfbodDavyavAkyAnAmanyasanniDivAcyayoH । prastAvakAladeSAnAM kAkoScezwAdikasya ca । vESizwyAdanyamarTaM yA boDayet sArTasamBavA ॥” vyaYjanA iti saMvaDyate । tatra vaktfvAkyaprastAvadeSakAlavESizwye yaTA mama । “kAlo maDuH kupita eza ca puzpaDanvA DIrA vahanti ratiKedaharAH samIrAH । kelIvanIyamapi vaYjulakuYjamaYjurdUre patiH kaTaya kiM karaRIyamadya ॥” atra etaM deSaM prati SIGraM pracCannakAmukastvayA prezyatAmiti saKIM prati kayAcit dyotyate ॥ * ॥ bodDavyavESizwye yaTA, -- “niHSezacyutacandanaM stanatawaM nirmfzwarAgo'Daro netre dUramanaYjane pulakitA tanvI taveyaM tanuH । miTyAvAdini dUti bAnDavajanasyAjYAtapIqAgame vApIM snAtumito gatAsi na punastasyADamasyAntikam ॥” atra tadantikameva gatAsIti viparItalakzaRayA lakzyaM tasya ca rantumiti vyaNgyaM pratipAdya dUtIvESizwyAdboDyate ॥ * ॥ anyasanniDivESizwye yaTA, -- “ua niccala RipPandABisinI pattamBi rehE balAA । Rimmala maragaa BAaRa pariwWiA saMKa suttivva ॥” atra balAkAyA nizpandatvena viSvastatvaM tenAsya deSasya vijanatvamataH saNketasTAnametaditi kayApi sannihitapracCannakAmukaM pratyucyate । atrEva sTAnanirjanatvarUpavyaNgyArTavESizwyaM prayojanam । “BinnakaRWaDvanirDIrEH kAkurityaBiDIyate ॥” ityuktaprakArAyAH kAkorBedA AkArAdiByo jYAtavyAH ॥ * ॥ etadvESizwye yaTA, -- “guruparatantratayA vata dUrataraM deSamudyato gantum । alikulakokilalalite nezyati saKi ! suraBisamaye'sO ॥” atra nezyatItyapi tarhi ezyatyeva iti kAkvA vyajyate ॥ * ॥ cezwAvESizwye yaTA, -- “saNketakAlamanasaM viwaM jYAtvA vidagDayA । hasannetrArpitAkUtaM lIlApadmaM nimIlitam ॥” atra sanDyA saNketakAla iti padmanimIlanAdicezwayA kayAttit dyotyate । evaM vaktrAdInAM vyastasamastAnAM vESizwye bodDavyam ॥ * ॥ “trEDiDyAdiyamarTAnAM pratyekaM triviDA matA ॥” arTAnAM vAcyalakzyavyaNgyatvena trirUpatayA sarvvA apyanantaroktA vyaYjanAstriviDAH । tatra vAcyArTasya vyaYjanA yaTA । kAlo maDurityAdi ॥ lakzyArTasya yaTA । niHSezacyutacandanamityAdi ॥ vyaNgyArTasya yaTA । ua Riccala ityAdi ॥ * ॥ prakftipratyayAdivyaYjanantu prapaYcayizyate । “SabdaboDyo vyanaktyarTaH Sabdo'pyarTAntarASrayaH । ekasya vyaYjakatve tadanyasya sahakAritA ॥” yataH Sabdo vyaYjakatve'rTAntaramapekzyate । arTo'pi SabdaM tadekasya vyaYjakatve'nyasya sahakAritvamavaSyamaNgIkaraRIyam । “aBiDAditrayopADivESizwyAttriviDo mataH । Sabdo'pi vAcakastadvallakzako vyaYjakastaTA ॥” aBiDopADiko vAcakaH । lakzaRopADiko lakzakaH । vyaYjanopADiko vyaYjakaH । kiYca । “tAtparyyAKyAM vfttimAhuH padArTAnvayaboDane । tAtparyyArTaM tadarTaYca vAkyaM tadboDakaM pare ॥” aBiDAyA ekEkapadArTaboDanaviramAt vAkyArTarUpasya padAnvayasya boDikA tAtparyyA nAma vfttistadarTaSca tAtparyyArTastadboDakaYca vAkyamityaBihitAnvayavAdinAM matam । iti sAhityadarpaRe vAkyasvarUpanirUpaRo nAma dvitIyaH paricCedaH ॥

dUti! bAnDavajanasyAjYAtapIqAgame vAzIM Atumito gatAsi na punastasyADamasyAntikam” । atra tadantikameva gatAsIti viparItalakzaRayA lakzyam । tasya ca rantumiti vyaNgAM pratipAdyadUtAvESizwyAdboDyate । asyasanniDivESizwye yaTA “ua Riccala RippandA BisiRIpattammi rehai balAA । RimmalamaragaaBAaRapariWWiA saMKasutti vva” । atra balAkAyA nisyandatvena viSvastatvaM tenAsya deSasya vijanatvamataH saNketasTAnametaditi kaTApi sannihitapracCannakAmukaM pratyucyate। atrEva sTAnanirjanatva vyaNgArTa vESizwyaM prayo janam । “BinnakaRWaDvanirDIrEH kAkurityaBiDIyate” । ityuktaprakArAyAH kAkorBedA AkArAdiByo jYAtavyAH । etadvOSizwya yaTA “guruparantratayA vata dUrataraM deSamudyato gantum । alikulakokilalalite nEzyati saKi! suraBisalaye'sO” । atra nEzyati api tu evyatyeveti kAkvA vyajyate । cezwAvESizwye yaTA “saNketakAlamanasaM viwaM jYAtvA vidagDayA । hasannetrArpitAkUtaM lIlApadmaM nimIlitam” । atra sanDyA saNketakAla iti padmanimIlanAdicezwayA kayAcit dyotyate । evaM vaktrAdInAM vyastasamastAnAM vESizwye boDyam । “trEviDyAdiyamarTAnAM pratyekaM triviDA matA” । arTAnAM vAcyalakzyavyaNgyatvena trirUpatayA sarvA apyanantaroktA vyaYjanAstriviDAH । tatra vAcyArTasya vyaYjanA yaTA “kAlI maGuH” ityAdi । lakzyArTasya yaTA “niHSezacyutacandanam” ityAdi । vyaNgyArTasya yaTA “ua RiccametyAdi” । prakftipratyayavyaYjanatvantu prapaYcayizyate “SabdoboDyo vyanaktyarTaM Sabdo'pyarTAntarAcayaH । ekasya vyaYjakatve tadanyasya sahakAritA” । yataH Sabdo vyaYjakatve'rTAntaramapekzate arTo'pi Sabda, tadekasya vyaNjakatve anyasya sahakAritA'vaSyamaNgIkAryyA । “aBiDAditrayoprADivESizwyAttriviDo mataH । Sabdo'pi vAcakastadvallakzako vyaYjakastaTA” । aBiDopADiko vAcakaH । lakzaRopADiko lakzakaH । vyaYjanopADiko vyaYjakaH” sA॰ da॰ 2
m: व्य्-अञ्जन mfn. manifesting, indicating, Hariv. (v.l. व्यञ्चन)
व्य्-अञ्जन m. (once for n.; cf. below) a consonant, VPrāt.
व्य्-अञ्जन m. Pandanus Odoratissimus, L.
= वादित्र-कर्मन्, L.
व्य्-अञ्जन n. decoration, ornament, RV. viii, 78, 2
manifestation, indication, Suśr.; Rājat.
व्य्-अञ्जन n. allusion, suggestion (= आ f.), Sah, ĀśvŚr., Sch.
व्य्-अञ्जन n. figurative expression, irony, sarcasm, W.
specification, Nir.
a mark, badge, spot, sign, token, ĀpŚr.; R.; Kathās. &c.
insignia, paraphernalia, Kāv.
symptom (of a disease), Cat.
mark of sex or gender (as the beard, breasts &c.), the private organs (male or female), GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c.
anything used in cooking or preparing food, seasoning, sauce, condiment, MBh.; R. &c.
a consonant, Prāt.; ŚrS. &c.
a syllable, VPrāt. (cf. हीनव्य्˚)
the letter (as opp. to अर्थ, ‘meaning’), Mahāvy.
a limb, member, part, L.
a day, L.
व्य्-अञ्जन n. purification of a sacrificial animal (also m. and f(आ). ), L.
व्य्-अञ्जन n. a fan, L. (w.r. for व्यजन)

k.v: व्यञ्जनं लाञ्छनं श्मश्रु निष्ठानावयवेष्वपि। स्यात्कौलीनं लोकवादे युद्धे पश्वहि पक्षिणाम्.।
व्यञ्जनं लाञ्छनं श्मश्रु निष्ठानावयवेष्वपि। स्यात्कौलीनं लोकवादे युद्धे पश्वहि पक्षिणाम्.।
व्यञ्जनं लाञ्छनं श्मश्रु निष्ठानावयवेष्वपि। स्यात्कौलीनं लोकवादे युद्धे पश्वहि पक्षिणाम्.।
व्यञ्जनं लाञ्छनं श्मश्रु निष्ठानावयवेष्वपि। स्यात्कौलीनं लोकवादे युद्धे पश्वहि पक्षिणाम्.।

m: व्य्-अञ्जन—गुण m. (?) N. of wk. on condiments in cookery
व्य्-अञ्जन—हारिका f. N. of a female demon supposed to remove the hair of a woman's pudenda, MārkP.
व्य्-अञ्जन—कार m. the preparer of a sauce or condiment, MBh.
व्य्-अञ्जन—स्थाने ind. in the place of sauce or seasoning, ib.
व्य्-अञ्जन—संधि m. (in gram.) the junction of consonants, ib.,
व्य्-अञ्जन—संगम m. a collection or group of consonants, MW.
व्य्-अञ्जन—संनिपात m. a falling together or conjunction of consonants, ib.
व्य्-अञ्जन्˚इक n. (with स्वराणाम्) N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of the VS.
व्य्-अञ्ज˚नोदय mfn. followed by a consonant, MW.
व्य्-अञ्ज˚नोपध mfn. preceded by a c˚, ib.
व्य्-अञ्जिजिषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to make clear or manifest, W.

v: tri॰ vi + anja--Ric--kta । 1 prakASite “avyaYjitaharzalakzaRaH” kumAraH । 2 vyaYjanAvfttyA boDite'rTe ca ।
m: व्य्-अञ्जित mfn. (fr. Caus.) clearly manifested or made visible
व्य्-अञ्जित—वृत्ति-भेद mfn. having various actions manifested, MW.

1. व्यच् (cf. √ विच्; prob. orig. identical with 2. व्य्-√ अच्) cl. 6. P. (Dhātup. xxviii, 12) विचति (only in cl. 3. pr. विव्यक्ति, 3. du. विविक्तस्, Subj. विव्यचत्, RV. ; impf. अविव्यक्, 3. pl. अविव्यचुस्, ib.; pf. विव्याच, 2. sg. विव्यक्थ, ib.; Br.; Gr. also aor. अव्याचीत् or अव्यचीत्; Prec. विच्यात्; fut. व्यचिता, विचिता; व्यचिष्यति; inf. व्यचितुम्; ind.p. विचित्वा), to encompass, embrace, comprehend, contain, RV.; AitBr.; (विचति) to cheat, trick, deceive, Dhātup. : Caus. व्याचयति (aor. अविव्यचत्) Gr.: Desid. विव्यचिषति, ib. : Intens. वेविच्यते, वाव्यचीति, वाव्यक्ति, ib.
2. व्य्-√ अच् (or अञ्च्), P. Ā. -अचति, ˚ते, to bend asunder, make wide, extend, RV.; AV.
a: व्यच् — {c6c} P. (विचति, pass. विच्यते) 1 To cheat, deceive, trick. --2 To surround, encompass, pervade.

m: व्यच्छ See गो-व्यच्छ.

s: Si vyAje । sambanDe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudA॰-kuwA॰-para॰-saka॰-sew .) vyAjaSCalaH । Sa, vicati sataM KalaH । Calayati ityarTaH । avicIt vivyAca । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: vyAje aka॰ sambanDe saka॰ tu॰ ku॰ para॰ sew । vicati avicIt viDyAca vivicatuH vyacAH ।

m: व्यचस् n. expanse, capacity, compass, RV.; AV.; VS.
wide space, free scope, room, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. (व्यचस्-√ कृ, to dilate, expand, open, Kauś.)
a: व्यचस् — n. Ved. Expanse, vastness.

m: व्यचस्—काम mfn. desirous of wide space, Kauś.
व्यचस्—वत् (व्यचस्-), mfn. spacious, expansive, RV.; VS.
व्यचिष्ठ mfn. (superl.) most spacious or expansive, RV.
व्य्-√ अद् P. -अत्ति, to bite through or on all sides, gnaw, nibble, eat, R.
व्य्-अद्वर m. (f(व्य्-अद्वरी). , AV.) a gnawing animal, ŚBr. (cf. व्यध्वर).
व्यद्य n. a partic. Sūkta, Kauś.

m: व्य्—अग्र See s.v.
व्य्-अग्र mf(आ)n. not attending to any one partic. point (opp. to एकाग्र), distracted, inattentive
bewildered, agitated, excited, alarmed, MaitrUp.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
diverted from everything else, intent on, engrossed by, eagerly occupied with or employed in (instr. loc., or comp.; sometimes said of hands and fingers), MBh.; Hariv.; Kāv. &c.
tottering, unsteady, exposed to dangers (see अ-व्य्˚)
being in motion (as a wheel), BhP.
व्य्-अग्र m. N. of Viṣṇu, MW.
a: व्यग्र — a. [विगतमग्रं यस्य] 1 Bewildered, perplexed, distracted. --2 Alarmed, frightened. --3 Eagerly or intently occupied (with loc., instr. or in comp.); स राजककुदव्यग्रपाणिभिः पार्श्ववर्तिभिः R. 17. 27, Mv. 1. 13, 4. 28, Ku. 7. 2, U. 1. 23 Bv. 1. 123; Śi. 2. 79. --ग्रः N. of Viṣṇu.

k.v: जठरः कठिनेऽपि स्यादधस्तादपि चाधरः। अनाकुलेऽपि चैकाग्रो व्यग्रो व्यासक्त आकुले॥
जठरः कठिनेऽपि स्यादधस्तादपि चाधरः। अनाकुलेऽपि चैकाग्रो व्यग्रो व्यासक्त आकुले॥

m: व्य्-अग्र—हस्त mfn. having the hands occupied with (comp.), Divyāv.
व्य्-अग्रम् (अम्), ind. in an agitated manner, with great excitement, VarBṛS.
व्य्-अग्र—मनस् mfn. perplexed or bewildered in mind, ib.
व्य्-अग्र—पुरंध्रि-वर्ग mfn. having companies of matrons zealously occupied, MW.
व्य्-अग्र—ता f. intense occupation, eagerness, intentness (ifc.), Śak.; Pañcat. &c.
perplexity, confusion, MW.
व्य्-अग्र—त्व n. distraction
confusion, agitation, MaitrUp.; Pañcat.
(ifc.) intentness on Kull. on Mn. viii, 65
व्यग्रय Nom. P. ˚यति, to divert or distract any one's thoughts, Car.
व्य्-√ अह् (only 3. pl. pf. -आहुः), to explain, assign a reason, AitBr.
व्य्—अहन् or व्य्—अह्न (loc. ˚ह्नि, ˚हनि, or ˚ह्ने), Pāṇ. vi, 3, 110; Vop. iii, 42; (-अह्न), mfn. done or happening on separate days, MW.; (accord. to some ‘done or produced in two days’).
1. व्य्-√ अज् P. -अजति, to drive away (Pass. व्य्-अज्यते), RV. x, 85, 28; to go through or across, furrow, ib. v, 54, 4.
2. व्यज् (= √ वीज्, only in व्यजेत, Suśr.; for विव्यजुः See √ वीज्), to fan, ventilate.

s: puM, (vyajatyaneneti । vi + aja + “gocarasaYcareti .” 3 । 3 । 119 । iti GaY । nipAtanAdajervyaGaYaporiti vIBAvo na Bavati .) vyajanam । vipUrvvAjaDAtoralpratyayena nizpannamidam ॥
m: 1. व्य्-अज Pāṇ. iii, 3, 119.
2. व्यज m. a fan, W.
a: व्यजः — A fan.

व्यजनी—√ भू P. -भवति, to become or be a fan, Ragh.
व्यजनी—√ कृ P. -करोति, to make into (or, use as) a fan, Kād.

m: व्यजन n. (ifc. f(आ). ) fanning, Kād.
a palm-leaf or other article used for fanning, fan, whisk (often du.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: व्यजनं — A fan; निर्वाते व्यजनं H. 2. 165; R. 8. 40, 10. 62; cf. बालव्यजन.

k.v: दर्पणे मुकुरादर्शौ व्यजनं तालवृन्तकम्.।

m: व्यजन—चामर n. the tail of the Bos Grunniens used as a whisk or fan, a chowry (cf. चामरव्यजन).
व्यजनक n. = व्यजन, a fan, VarBṛS.
व्यजन—क्रिया f. the act of fanning, Kād.
व्यजनिन् m. the Yak (Bos Grunniens), L.
व्यकृड mfn. (applied to Rudra), MaitrS.
व्य्-अक्˚तावधूत mfn. one who has publicly shaken off worldly ties (opp. to गुप्ताव्˚, q.v.), W.
व्यक्ती in comp. for व्य्-अक्त.
व्यक्ती—भाव m. the becoming m˚ or clear or d˚, Śaṃk.
व्यक्ती—√ भू P. -भवति, to become m˚ or clear or d˚ (-भूत mfn. become manifest or clear or distinct), MBh.; VarBṛS.; Rājat.
a: व्यक्तीभू — {c1c} P. To become distinct or clear, become clearly visible.

m: व्यक्ती—करण n. the act of making manifest or clear or distinct, Dhātup.; Jātakam.
व्यक्ती—√ कृ P. -करोति, to make m˚ or clear or d˚ (-कृत mfn. made m˚ or clear or d˚), Kathās.
a: व्यक्तीकृ — {c8c} U. To make clear, show, manifest.

v: tri॰ vi + anja--kta । 1 sPuwe 2 prakASite medi॰ । 3 prAjYe amaraH । 4 sTUle “vyaktAvyaktajYavijYAnAt” sA॰ kA॰ । 5 vizRO pu॰ vizRuma॰ ।
m: व्य्-अक्त , व्य्-अक्ति. See cols. 2, 3.
व्य्-अक्त mfn. adorned, embellished, beautiful, RV.
caused to appear, manifested, apparent, visible, evident (अम्, ind. apparently, evidently, certainly), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
developed, evolved (see below)
distinct, intelligible (see -वाच्)
perceptible by the senses (opp. to अ-व्यक्त, transcendental), MBh.; BhP.
specified, distinguished, L.
specific, individual, L.
hot, L.
wise, learned, Lalit.
व्य्-अक्त m. heat, L.
a learned man, L.
an initiated monk, Śīl.
‘the manifested One’, N. of Viṣṇu, MW.
of one of the 11 Gaṇādhipas (with Jainas)
व्य्-अक्त n. (in Sāṃkhya) ‘the developed or evolved’ (as the product of अ-व्यक्त, q.v.), Sāṃkhyak. (cf. IW. 82)
a: व्यक्त — p. p. 1 Manifested, displayed. --2 Developed, created; Ku. 2. 11. --3 Evident, manifest, clear, plain, distinct, clearly visible; Pt. 2. 92. --4 Specified, known, distinguished. --5 Individual. --6 Wise, learned. --7 Ved. Adorned, decorated. --क्तः N. of Viṣṇu. --क्तं That which is developed as the product of अव्यक्त q. v. --क्तं ind. Clearly, evidently, certainly. --Comp. --गणितं arithmetic. --दृष्टार्थः an eye-witness, a witness in general. --राशिः a known quantity. --रूपः an epithet of Viṣṇu. --विक्रम a. displaying valour.

k.v: विष्णावप्यजिताव्यक्तौ सूतस्त्वष्टरि सारथौ। व्यक्तः प्राज्ञेऽपि दृष्टान्तावुभौ शास्त्रनिदर्शने॥

m: व्य्-अक्ति f. visible appearance or manifestation, becoming evident or known or public (acc. with √ भज्, आ-√ गम्, and आ-√ या, to appear, become manifest), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
specific appearance, distinctness, individuality, ib.
an individual (opp. to जाति), Bhag.; VarBṛS. &c.
(in gram.) gender, Pāṇ. i, 2, 51
case, inflection, the proper form of any inflected word, W.
a vowel (?), MW.
a: व्यक्तिः — f. 1 Manifestation, visibility; clear perception; राज्ञः समक्षमेवाधगोत्तरव्यक्तिर्भविष्यति M. 1; स्तेहव्याक्तिः Me. 12. --2 Visible appearance, clearness, distinctness; व्यक्तिं भजंत्यापगाः Ś. 7. 8. --3 Distinction, discrimination; तं संतः श्रोतुमर्हंति सदसद्व्यक्तिहेतवः R. 1. 10. --4 Real form or nature, true character; न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः Bg. 10. 14. --5 An individual (opp. जाति), as in जातिव्यक्ती; Bg. 8. 18. --6 Gender (in gram.). --7 Inflection.

k.v: जातिर्जातं च सामान्यं व्यक्तिस्तु पृथगात्मता। चित्तं तु चेतो हृदयं स्वान्तं हृन्मानसं मनः॥

m: व्य्-अक्ति—ता f. distinctness, individuality, personality, ib.
व्य्-अक्ति—त्व n. distinctness, individuality, personality, ib.
व्य्-अक्ति—विवेक m. N. of wk.
व्य्-अक्˚तोदित mfn. spoken clearly or plainly, MW.
व्य्-√ अक्ष् P. -अक्षति, or -अक्ष्णोति = व्य्-√ अश्, to pervade, &c., MW.
व्य्—अक्ष m. (cf. निरक्ष) ‘having no latitude’, the equator, Sūryas.
व्य्-अक्ष See p. 1028, col. 2.

s: klI, (viSezeRa alatIti । vi + ala + “alIkAdayaSca .” uRA॰ 4 । 25 । iti kIkanpratyayena nipAtanAt sADuH .) pIqArTaH । ityamaraH ॥ gativiparyyayaH । kAmajAparADaH । iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥ yaTA, -- “kftyaM nEva vijAnAti pareRApakftaM kvacit । kftyaYca saMsmaredetadasatyaYca na jalpati ॥ vyalIkezu nivftto yaH paryyeti kftaniScayaH । nityaYca DftimAn kiYcit parokze'pi na ca kzipet ॥ ftukAle'BigacCeta apatyArTaM svakAM striyam । IdfSAstu narA Badre mama karmmaparAyaRAH ॥” iti vArAhe yonigarBamokzaRanAmADyAyaH ॥ apriyam । (yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 6 । 9 । “na hi tena mama BrAtrA susUkzmamapi kiYcana । vyalIkaM kftapUrvvaM vE prAjYenAmitabudDinA ॥”) akAryyam । vElakzyam । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, kirAte । 3 । 19 । “yasminnanESvaryyakftavyalIkaH parABavaM prApta ivAntako'pi । DunvanDanuH kasya raRe na kuryyAt mano BayEkapravaRaM sa BIzmaH ॥”) aparADaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, SiSupAlavaDe । 9 । 85 । “sudfSaH sarasavyalIkataptastarasA SlizwavataH sayOvanozmA ॥”) pratAraRA । iti halAyuDaH ॥ (duHKam । iti vEjayantI ॥ yaTA, kumAre । 3 । 25 । “dig dakziRA ganDavarha muKena vyalIkaniSvAsamivotsasarjja ॥”) tadbati, tri ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 8 । 22 । 2 । “yadyuttamaHSloka BavAn mameritaM vaco vyalIkaM suravaryya manyate । karonvftaM tanna Bavet pralamBanaM padaM tftIyaM kuru SIrzRi me nijam ॥”)
puM, (vi + ala paryyAptO + kIkan .) nAgaraH । iti medinI ॥ tatparyyAyaH । ziqgaH 2 vawprajYaH 3 kAmakeliH 4 vidUzakaH 5 pIWakeliH 6 pAWamarddaH 7 BaNgilaH 8 CiduraH 9 viwaH 10 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: na॰ vi + ala--Ikak । 1 akAryye 2 vElakzye medi॰ 3 aparADe hemaca॰ 4 apriye 5 anfte ca amaraH । 6 tadvati tri॰ । 7 pratAraRAyAM halA॰ 8 gativiparyyaye BarataH ।
m: व्य्—अलीक mfn. very false or untruthful, lying, hypocritical (अम् ind.), Amar.; BhP.
disagreeable, painful, offensive, strange, MW.
improper or unfit to be done, MW.
not false, Śiś.
= व्यङ्ग्य, L.
व्य्—अलीक m. = नागर, L.
a catamite, MW.
व्य्—अलीक n. anything displeasing, ib.
any cause of pain or uneasiness, ib.
pain, grief, MBh.; Kāv.; Pur. &c.
a falsehood, lie, fraud (also pl.), Kāv.; Pur. &c.
transgression, offence, misdeed, Ratnāv.; Jātakam.
= वैलक्ष्य, L.
reverse, contrariety, inversion, MW.
व्य्-अलीक &c. See p. 1028, col. 3.
a: व्यलीक — a. 1 False, untrue. --2 Offensive, disagreeable, displeasing. --3 Not false; Śi. 5. 1. --4 Unfit to be done. --कः 1 A libertine. --2 A catamite. --कं 1 Anything disagreeable or displeasing, disagreeableness; इत्थं गिरः प्रिवतमा इव रोऽ व्यलीकाः शुश्राव सूततनयस्य तदा व्यलीकाः Śi. 5. 1. --2 Any cause of grief or uneasiness, pain, sorrow, grief; सुतनु हृदयात्प्रत्यादेशव्यलीकमपैतु ते Ś. 7. 24; यस्मिन्ननैश्वर्यकृतव्यलीकः पराभवं प्राप इवांतकोपि Ki. 3. 19; Ku. 3. 25; R. 4. 87. --3 A fault, an offence, a transgression, any improper act; सव्यलीकमवधीरितखिन्नं प्रस्थितं सपदि कोपपदेन Ki. 9. 45; Śi. 9. 85; एवं प्रत्यक्षदृष्टव्यलीकः किं ब्रवीमि Ratn. 3, 3. 15. --4 Fraud, trick, deception; Pt. 1. 120, 242. --5 Falsehood. --6 Inversion, contrariety.

k.v: शालावृकाः कपिक्रोष्टुश्वानः स्वर्णेऽपि गैरिकम्. पीडार्थेऽपि व्यलीकं स्यादलीकं त्वप्रियेऽनृते॥

व्य्—अल्कश mfn. (accord. to Sāy.) having various branches

व्य्—अम्ल—ता f.

व्य्—अन्˚ती-भाव m. the being removed, L.

absence of distinction, Hariv.
an interval, Gobh.

a: व्यनुनादः — Reverberation, loud echo.

a: व्यप् — {c10c} U. (व्यापयति-ते) 1 To throw. --2 To diminish, waste, decrease.

seat, place (ifc. = being in or on), R.; Kām.; Suśr.
place of refuge, shelter, support (ifc. = having recourse to, trusting in), MBh.; R. &c.
expectation, W.
a: व्यपाश्रयः — 1 Succession. --2 Taking refuge with, having recourse to, trusting to; Bg. 3. 18. --3 Depending on; धर्मो रामव्यपाश्रयः Rām. --4 Expectation.

m: व्य्-अपा-√ श्रि P. Ā. -श्रयति, ˚ते, to go to for refuge, have recourse to (acc.), MBh.; to adhere to any doctrine, confess (acc.), Śaṃk.
व्य्-˚अपाश्रित mfn. one who has taken refuge with (acc. or comp.), MBh.; Kathās.
having taken or assumed, MBh.; BhP.
व्य्-अपा-√ हृ P. -हरति, to withdraw from (abl.), MBh.

a: व्यपाकृतिः — f. 1 Expelling, driving away. --2 Denial.

व्य्-अपाय m. cessation, stop, end, MBh.; R. &c.
absence, want, Kathās.
a: व्यपायः — End, disappearance, close; Ku. 3. 33, R. 3. 37.

m: व्य्-अपदेश m. representation, designation, information, statement, RPrāt.; ŚrS. &c.
a name, title, Uttarar.
a family, race, Śak.
summons (of an army), R.
appeal to (gen.), Pañcat.
talk, speech, MBh. iii, 8665 (Nīlak.)
a partic. form of speech, MW.
fame, renown (see comp.)
fraud, stratagem, pretext, excuse (एन, under pretext or excuse [also -तस्] ifc. = under the pretext of), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

m: व्य्-अपदे˚शक mfn. designating, indicating, BhP.
व्य्-अपदेश—वत् mfn. having a partic. designation or name (with पितृ-तस्, designated by the name of the father), Pat.

v: tri॰ nimittasadBAvAd viSizwo'padeSA muKyo vyavahAro'syAsti ini । muKyavyavahAravizaye padArTe “vyapadeSivadekasmin” vyA॰ pa॰ । vyapadeSena tulyaM parttate iti vati । kAryyaM prati ekAsmannasahAye'pi tat kAryyaM karttavyamiti tadarTaH ।
m: व्य्-˚अपदेशिन् mfn. having a name or designation, L.
(ifc.) denoting, indicating, Śaṃk.
(ifc.) conforming to, following the advice of R.
व्य्-˚अपदेश्य mfn. to be designated or indicated or named, R.; Pat.; Śaṃk.
to be censured or blamed, Hariv.
व्य्-˚अपदेष्टृ mfn. one who represents or shows or names, W.
one who represents falsely, a cheat, impostor, ib.
a: व्यपदेष्टृ — m. A cheat, an impostor.

व्य्-अप-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to point out, indicate, intend, mean, designate, name, mention, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (often Pass. -दिश्यते, ‘so it is represented or intended or signified’); to represent falsely, feign, pretend, MBh.; R.; Prasannar.
a: व्यपदिश् — {c6c} P. 1 To name, call; व्यपदिश्यसे जगति विक्रमीत्यतः Śi. 15. 28. --2 To name or call falsely; मित्रं च मां व्यपदिशस्यपरं च यासि Mk. 4. 9. --3 To speak of, profess; जन्मेंदोर्विमले कुले व्यपदिशसि Ve. 6. 7. --4 To pretend, feign; Mv. 2. 11. --5 To indicate, show. --6 To signify, mean, denote.

m: व्यपदिष्ट mfn. pointed out &c.
informed, W.
tricked, ib.
pleaded as an excuse, ib.
a: व्यपदिष्ट — p. p. 1 Named. --2 Shown, represented, signified. --3 Pleaded as a pretext or excuse.

m: व्य्-अप-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go away, retreat, escape, disappear, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to move away from, be entirely removed or distant, VarBṛS.
a: व्यपगम् — {c1c} P. 1 To go away, retire, retreat. --2 To disappear, vanish.

m: व्य्-अप-˚गम m. passing away, lapse (of time), Kull. on Mn. v, 66
disappearance, Amar.
a: व्यपगमः — Departure, disappearance.

m: व्य्-अप-˚गत mfn. gone away, disappeared (see comp.)
fallen away from (abl.), R.
a: व्यपगत — p. p. 1 Gone away, departed, disappeared; मदो मे व्य गतः Bh. 2. 8; Me. 76. --2 Removed. --3 Fallen away from, deprived of, free from.

m: व्य्-अप-˚गत—शुच् mfn. whose sorrow his departed, free from grief, MW.
व्य्-अप-˚गत—रश्मि-वत् mfn. whose rays have disappeared, ray less, Sūryas., Sch.
व्य्-अप-˚गत—तिलकगात्र-ता f. the having limbs free from freckles (one of the 80 minor marks of a Buddha), Dharmas. 84
व्य्-अप-√ हा (only ind.p. -हाय), to relinquish, abandon, Hariv.
व्य्-अप-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to strike off, R. (B.); to keep off, prevent, Sāh.
व्य्-अप-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to cut off, MBh.; to take away, remove, destroy, Rājat.
व्य्-˚अपकर्ष m. exception (from a rule), Pat.

a: व्यपकृष् — {c1c} P. 1 To draw away. --2 To lead astray, seduce. --3 To remove, take away.

m: व्य्-˚अपकृष्ट mfn. drawn off, taken away, removed, MBh.
a: व्यपकृष्ट — p. p. Drawn aside, taken away, removed.

m: व्य्-अप-√ क्रम् P. -क्रामति, to go off retire, depart, R.
व्य्—अपमूर्धन् mfn. headless, L.
व्य्-अप-√ मुच् P. -मुञ्चति, to loosen, take off, R.

व्य्-अप-√ नी P. -नयति (inf. -नेतुम्, or -नयितुम्), to lead or take away, MBh.; R.; to drive away, remove, banish, ib. &c.; to pour out or away, AitBr.; to take off, lay aside, get rid of (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -नाययति, to cause to take away or remove, MBh.
व्य्-अपनीत mfn. led off, taken away, removed, R.
व्य्-अप-√ नश् Caus. -नाशयति to cause to disappear or perish, drive away, remove, MBh.
व्य्-अपनय m. taking away, removal, MBh. (v.l. व्य्-अपयन).
व्य्-˚अपनयन n. tearing off, removing, Veṇīs.
व्य्-˚अपनेय mfn. to be taken away or removed, MBh.
व्य्-अप-√ नुद् P. -नुदति, to drive away, remove, MBh.
व्य्-अप˚नुत्ति f. driving away, removal, AitBr.

v: na॰ vi + apa + ruha--Ric--lyuw hasya paH । 1 Cedane 2 utpAwane ।
m: व्य्-अपरोपण n. rooting up, extirpating, removing, destroying, Kām.; Sarvad.
tearing out, pulling (cf. केश-व्य्˚).
a: व्यपरोपणं — 1 Extirpating, uprooting. --2 Expelling, removing, driving away. --3 Cutting off, tearing out, plucking; चुकोप तस्मै स भृशं सुरस्त्रियः प्रसह्यकेशव्यपरोपणादिव R. 3. 56.

v: tri॰ vi + apa + ruha--Ric--kta hasya paH । 1 Cinne 2 utpAwite ca ।
m: व्य्-˚अपरोपित mfn. rooted up, extirpated, removed, expelled, W.
व्य्-अप-√ रुध् (only 2. sg. Intens. -रोरुधः), to exclude from sovereignty, dethrone, R. (B.)
व्य्-अप-√ रुह् Caus. -रोपयति, to lay aside, remove, take off, R.; to deprive of, expel from (instr. or abl.), MBh.; to root up, eradicate, extirpate (see next).
a: व्यपरुह् — Caus. 1 To eradicate, extirpate. --2 To remove. --3 To deprive of.

m: व्य्-˚अपसारण n. (fr. Caus.) driving away, dispelling, Rāghav.
व्य्-अप-√ स्फुर् Ā. -स्फुरते, to break (intr.) or burst asunder, KātyŚr., Sch.
व्य्-˚अपस्फुरण n. bursting asunder, KātyŚr.
व्य्-अप-सं-√ सृ (only ind.p. -सृत्य), to go through (a series of existences), Divyāv.
व्य्-अप-√ सृ P. -सरति, to go asunder or in different directions, MBh.; to depart from (abl.), Sarasv.
व्य्-अप-√ सृज् P. -सृजति, to hurl, cast, discharge (arrows &c.), MBh.; to take off, relinquish (a garment), ib.
व्य्-अप-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to go or creep or run away, escape, MBh.
व्य्-अप-˚त्राप्य (?) n. id., Divyāv.
व्य्-अप-√ त्रप् Ā. -त्रपते (rarely ˚ति), to turn away through shame, become shy or timid, MBh.; R.
a: व्यपत्रप् — {c1c} A. 1 To turn away through shame. --2 To be ashamed, feel ashamed.

m: व्य्—अपत्रपा (आ), f. See under व्य्-अप-√ त्रप्.
व्य्-अप-˚त्रपा f. (for व्य्-अपत्रप See p. 1028, col. 3) shame, embarrassment, R.
व्य्—अपत्रप mfn. shameless, MW.
a: व्यपत्रप — a. Shameless, impudent.

m: व्य्-अप-वह् See व्य्-अपोह्.
व्य्-अपवर्ग m. separation, division, difference, Pat.
cessation, termination, Jaim.

a: व्यपवर्तनं — Return.

m: व्य्-अप-वृज् Caus. -वर्जयति, to give up entirely, relinquish, Ragh.
व्य्-अपवृक्त mfn. separated, divided, Pat.
व्य्-अप-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते, to turn away, desist from (abl.), Uttarar.
a: व्यपवृत् — {1} A 1 To return, turn back; चेतः कथं कथमपि व्य पवर्तते मे Māl. 1. 18. --2 To desist from, leave; U. 5. 8.

m: व्य्-अप-विद्ध mfn. (√ व्यध्) thrown about, broken to pieces (-बृशी-मठ mfn. with abandoned seats and cells), MBh.
cast away, rejected, MBh.
pierced, transfixed, MBh.
व्य्-अप-विद्ध—बृशी-मठ mfn., with abandoned seats and cells
व्य्-अप-√ या P. -याति, to go away, retire, withdraw, MBh.; Hariv.; to pass away, vanish, R.
व्य्-˚अपयान n. retreat, flight, ib.
व्य्-अप-˚यात mfn. gone away, retired, MBh.
व्य्-अपे (-अप- √ 5. इ) P. -अपैति, to go apart or asunder, separate, MBh.; to cease, disappear, Mn.; Prab.
a: व्यपे — {c2c} P. 1 To depart or deviate from, be free from; व्यपेतमदमत्सरः Y. 1. 268; स्मृत्याचारव्यपेतेन मार्गेण 2. 5. --2 To go away, separate, part asunder; समेत्य च व्यपेयातां H. 4. 69; Ms. 9. 142; 11. 98.

m: व्य्-अपेक्ष् (-अप-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -अपेषते, to look about, look for, regard, mind, pay regard or attention to (acc.), R.; Ragh.
a: व्यपेक्ष् — {c1c} A. 1 To mind, care for, regard; न व्यपैक्षत समुत्सुकाः प्रजाः R. 19. 6. --2 To expect.

v: strA vi + apa + Ikza--a । apekzAyAM vyAkaraRokte avayapArTApekzaRe ca ।
m: व्य्-˚अपेक्षा f. regard, consideration (ifc. regarding, minding), MBh.; R. &c.
looking for, expectation (ifc. expectant of), BhP.; Kathās.
requisite, supposition (see स-व्य्˚)
application, use, W.
(in gram.) rection, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 1, Sch.
the mutual application of two rules, W.
a: व्यपेक्षा — 1 Expectation, hope. --2 Regard, consideration; R. 8. 24. --3 Mutual relation, inter-dependence. --4 Mutual regard. --5 Application. --6 (In gram.) The mutual application of two rules.

m: व्य्-˚अपेक्ष (ifc.) See ˚अपेक्षा below.
a: व्यपेक्ष — a. 1 Expecting, expectant. --2 Eager, attentive. --3 Regarding, minding.

m: व्य्-˚अपेक्षणीय mfn. to be looked for or expected, ib.
व्य्-˚अपेक्षण n. looking for, expectation, regard, consideration, W.
a: व्यपेक्षणं — Expecting, expectation.

m: व्य्-˚अपेक्षक mfn. mindful of (comp.), MBh.
व्य्-˚अपेक्षित mfn. looked for, expected, MW.
mutually expected or looked to, ib.
mutually related
employed, applied, ib.
a: व्यपेक्षित — p. p. 1 Hoped, expected. --2 Regarded, minded. --3 Mutually connected. --4 Employed, applied, used.

m: व्य्-˚अपेक्ष्य mfn. to be looked for or expected, ib.
व्य्-अपेत mfn. gone apart or asunder, separated, MBh.
passed away, disappeared, ceased, Mn.; MBh. &c.
(ifc.) opposed to, Yājñ.
a: व्यपेत — p. p. 1 Separated, severed. --2 Gone away, departed; oft. in comp.; व्यपेतकल्मष, व्यपेतभी, व्यपेतहर्ष &c. --3 Contrary, opposed to.

m: व्य्-अपेत—भी mfn. free from fear, ib.
व्य्-अपेत—भय mfn. free from fear, ib.
व्य्-अपेत—धैर्य mfn. one who has abandoned firmness, MBh.
व्य्-अपेत—घृण mfn. devoid of compassion, pitiless, Amar.
व्य्-अपेत—हर्ष mfn. devoid of joy, R.
व्य्-अपेत—कल्मष mfn. having taint or guilt removed, free from sin, Mn. iv, 260
व्य्-अपेत—मद-मत्सर mfn. free from infatuation and selfishness, Yājñ.
व्य्-˚अपोढाभ्र mfn., having the clouds driven away
व्य्-˚अपोढ mfn. driven away, removed, destroyed (˚ढाभ्र mfn. having the clouds driven away), MBh.
manifested, displayed, exhibited, ib.
opposite, contrary, reverse, W.
a: व्यपोढ — p. p. 1 Expelled, removed. --2 Contrary, opposite; Ki. 4. 15. --3 Manifested, displayed, shown.

m: व्य्-अपोह् (-अप- √ 1. ऊह्) P. -अपोहति (ep. also ˚ते), to drive away, keep off, remove, destroy, TUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to atone for, expiate (guilt), Mn. ii, 102 &c.; to heal, cure (sickness), Suśr.
a: व्यपोह् — {c1c} P. 1 To atone for, expiate. --2 To heal, cure. --3 To drive away, remove, keep off.

m: व्य्-˚अपोह m. driving away, keeping off, removal, destruction, MBh.; Suśr.
denial, negation, Sāh.
sweepings, rubbish, MBh.
a: व्यपोहः — Expelling, driving a way, keeping off.

m: व्य्-˚अपोहक mfn. driving away, removing, Car.
व्य्-˚अपोहन-स्तोत्र n. N. of a Stotra (prob. = व्यपोह-स्तव).
व्य्-˚अपोह—स्तव m. N. of a ch. of the LiṅgaP.
व्य्-˚अपोह्य mfn. deniable (see अ-व्य्˚).
व्यड m. N. of a man, Vop. (cf. व्याडि).

a: व्यडंबकः, व्यडंबनः — The castor-oil plant.

v: pu॰ qavi--Rvul viSezeRa na qambakaH । eraRqavfkze amaraH ।
m: व्यडम्बक or व्यडम्˚बन, n. the castor oil plant, Ricinus Communis, L.

k.v: एरण्ड उरुबूकश्च रुचकश्चित्रकश्च सः। चञ्चुः पञ्चाङ्गुलो मण्डवर्धमानव्यडम्बकाः॥

m: व्यड्ड m. N. of a man, Rājat. (also -मण्डल, ib.)
व्य्-अर्धुक mfn. (√ ऋध्) being deprived of (instr.), Maitr.; ĀpŚr.
1. व्य्—अर्ण mfn. (for 2. See व्य्-√ अर्द्) waterless, without water, PañcavBr.; ŚrS.
1. 2. व्य्-अर्ण. See ib. and below under व्य्-√ अर्द्.
2. व्य्-अर्ण or व्य्-अर्ण्ण, mfn. (cf. Pāṇ. vii, 2, 24) oppressed, harassed (see अ-व्यर्ण).
व्य्-अर्˚थी-√ भू P. -भवति, to become useless, Naiṣ.; Kād.
व्य्-अर्˚थी-√ कृ P. -करोति, to make useless or superfluous, Prab.; Kād.

s: tri, (vigato'rTo yasmAt .) nirarTakam । tatparyyAyaH । moGam 2 viPalam 3 । iti jawADaraH ॥ (yaTA, kumAre । 3 । 75 । “SElAtmajApi piturucCiraso'BilAzaM vyarTaM samarTya lalitaM vapurAtmanaSca ॥”)
v: tri॰ vigato'rTaH prayojanaM vA'sya । 1 nizpayojane 2 viPale jawA॰ 3 arTaSUnye ca ।
m: व्य्—अर्थ See s.v.
व्य्-अर्थ mf(आ)n. (fr. 3. वि + अर्थ) useless, unavailing, unprofitable, vain, MBh. &c. &c.
deprived or devoid of property or money, Pañcat.
excluded from, having no right (instr.), Āpast.
unmeaning, inconsistent, Hariv.; Kāvyād.
= ˚थ-नामक below, MBh.
a: व्यर्थ — a. [विगतोऽर्थः प्रयोजनं वाऽस्य] 1 Useless, vain, fruitless, unprofitable; व्यर्थं यत्र कपींद्रसख्यमपि मे U. 3. 45. --2 Meaningless, unmeaning, idle.

m: व्य्-˚अर्थक mfn. useless, vain, R.
a: व्यर्थक — = व्यर्थ.

m: व्य्-˚अर्थक—ता, f. (Śiś.) or व्य्-˚अर्थक—त्व, n. (MW.) uselessness.
व्य्-अर्थम् ind. uselessly, in vain, without having effected one's object, Kāv.; Pañcat. &c.
व्य्-अर्थ—नामक mfn. having a name inconsistent with one's character, MBh.
व्य्-अर्थ—नामन् mfn. having a name inconsistent with one's character, MBh.
व्य्-अर्थ—ता f. uselessness (˚तां-√ या, or √ गम्, to become useless), Pañcat.; Kusum.
absence of meaning, nonsense, R.
falseness, MBh.
inoffensiveness, MW.
व्य्-अर्थ—त्व n. absence of meaning, contradictoriness, Kāvyād., Sch.
व्यर्थय Nom. P. ˚यति, to make useless or superfluous, Campak.
व्य्-अर्थ—यत्न mfn. useless in its efforts, Hit.
व्य्-√ अर्द् P. -अर्दति, to flow away, ŚBr.; to oppress, harass, pain (see अ-व्यर्ण) : Caus. -अर्दयति, to cause to be scattered or dissolved, destroy, annihilate, RV.
व्य्—अर्क mfn. with exception of the sun, VarBṛ.
व्य्-अर्क See p. 1028, col. 3.
व्य्-अर्पणा f. (of unknown meaning), Mahāvy.

व्य्-√ 2. अस् अस् P. -अस्यति (ep. pf. विव्यास as if fr. a √ व्यस्), to throw or cast asunder or about or away, throw (effort) into, divide, separate, dispose, arrange ; scatter, disperse; expel, remove, RV. &c. &c.
a: व्यस् — {c4c} P. 1 To toss about, scatter, cast or throw asunder; dispel, destroy; प्राप्तो व्यालतमान् व्यस्यन् भुजंगेभ्योऽपि राक्षसान् Bk. 8. 116, 9. 31. --2 To divide into parts, separate, arrange; स्वयं वेदान् व्यस्यन् Pt. 4. 50; विव्यात वेदान् यस्मात्स तस्माद् व्यास इति स्मृतः Mb.; R. 10. 84. --3 To take separately or singly; see व्यस्त below. --4 To throw over, overturn, upset. --5 To expel, remove, drive away.

m: व्य्—अस्थक mfn. boneless, PañcavBr.
व्य्-अस˚नागम m. approach of calamity, Śukas.
व्य्-अस˚नाक्रान्त-त्व n. distressful condition, grievous distress, MW.
व्य्-अस˚नानन्तरम् ind. immediately after misfortune, Kāv.
व्य्-अस˚नान्वित mfn. involved in or overwhelmed with c˚, MW.
व्य्-अस˚नापात m. (= ˚नागम), Rājat.
व्य्-अस˚नाप्लुत mfn. involved in or overwhelmed with c˚, MW.
व्य्-अस˚नार्त mfn. afflicted by calamity, suffering pain, L.

k.v: आक्षारितः क्षारितोऽभिशस्ते सङ्कसुकोऽस्थिरे। व्यसनार्तोपरक्तौ द्वौ विहस्तव्याकुलौ समौ॥

m: व्य्-अस˚नातिभार mfn. weighed down or overburdened with misfortunes, MW.
व्य्-अस˚नात्यय m. the passing away of calamity or distress, BhP.
व्य्-अस˚नावाप m. receptacle or abode of calamity, BhP.

s: [n] tri, (vyasanamasyAstIti । vyasana + iniH .) vyasana-viSizwaH । (yaTA, SiSupAlavaDe । 2 । “cirasya mitravyasanI sudamo damaGozajaH ॥”) tatparyyAyaH । paYcaBadraH 2 viplutaH 3 । iti hemacandraH ॥

m: व्यसनी-√ कृ P. -करोति, to consider or characterize as a vice, Jātakam.
व्यसनीय m. a vicious person, profligate, libertine, W.

s: klI, (vi + asa + lyuw .) vipat । (yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 227 । 7 । “putradArEH suKEScEva viyuktasya Danena vA । magnasya vyasane kfcCre DftiH SreyaskarI nfpa ! ॥”) BraMSaH । (yaTA, manO । 7 । 93 । “nAyuDavyasanaprAptaM nArttaM nAtiparIkzitam ॥”) kAmajakopajadozaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 11 । 25 । “tanmuYca vyasanAni tvaM suKena hi parErnfpAH । sIdantastezu gfhyante KAtezviva vanadvipAH ॥” yaTA ca BAgavate । 4 । 26 । 26 । 4 । “vihAya jAyA matadarhAM mfgavyasanalAlasaH ॥” “vyasanaM BogAsaktiH .” iti SrIDaraH ॥) vipat vipattiH । BraMSo'pAyaH patanam । mfgayAdyUtastrImadyapAnasvarUpe caturvvarge prasaktiH kAmajo dozaH । icCApraBavatvAt । vAkpAruzyaM arTapAruzyaYceti trivargaH kopajo dozaH । kopapraBavatvAt । ezu vyasanam । vyasyati SreyomArgAt vyasanaM karttari anaw । BraMSe tu BAve । iti BarataH ॥ (atyAsaktiH । yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 11 । 32 । “SiTilI kftakElAsanivAsavyasano haraH ॥”) aSuBam । dEvAnizwaPalam । pApam । nizPalodyamaH । iti medinI ॥ * ॥ rAjYAM vyasanAni yaTA, “mfgayAkzAH striyaH pAnaM vAkpAruzyArTadUzaRe । daRqapAruzyamityetadDeyaM vyasanasaptakam ॥” iti hemacandraH ॥ * ॥ vyasanAsakte dozo yaTA, -- “ekEkavizayAsaktAH sarvve mftyuvaSaM gatAH । yaH punaH saMhatAn sevet vizayAn vizayI naraH । sa patenmahadESvaryyAcCinnamUla iva drumaH ॥ striyaH pAnaM divAsvapnaM taTA vAditranarttanam । dyUtAwanamfgAgeyakAmajAni taTA pare ॥ daRqErvAcA IrzyAsUyA kroDapESunyasAhasam । arTa dUzaRakroDo'rTe azwakopaM vinASakft ॥ devA vidyADarA yakzAH kinnaroragamAnuzAH । paSavaH pakziRaH sarvve vizaye niDanaM gatAH ॥ evaM vivekamAsaktaM budDvA GoraM narADipa । DavyarmmAjaM samAsTAya vizayEH sanniveSyatAm ॥” iti devIpurARe 8 aDyAyaH ॥
