m: व्य्-असन n. moving to and fro, wagging (of a tail), Pāṇ. iii, 1, 20, Vārtt. 3
throwing (effort) into, assiduity, industry, Bhartṛ.; Subh.
separation, individuality, W.

attachment or devotion or addiction to (loc. or comp.), passion, (esp.) evil passion, sin, crime, vice (said to arise either from love of pleasure or from anger; eight are enumerated under the first head, viz. मृगया, द्यूत or अक्ष, दिवा-स्वप्न, परिवाद, स्त्रियः, मद, तौर्य-त्रिक, वृथात्या; and eight under the second, viz. पैशुन्य, साहस, द्रोह, इर्ष्या, असूया, अर्थ-दूषण, वाक्पारुष्य, दण्ड-पारुष्य, qq.vv.), Mn. vii, 47, 48; MBh. &c.
favourite pursuit or occupation, hobby, MBh.; Pañcat.; Rājat.
evil predicament or plight, disaster, accident, evil result, calamity, misfortune (व्यसनानि pl. misfortunes), ill-luck, distress, destruction, defeat, fall, ruin, Mn.; MBh. &c.
setting (of sun or moon), Mṛcch.; Śak.
fruitless effort, L.
punishment, execution (of criminals), MW.
incompetence, inability, W.
air, wind, ib.
tale-bearing, L.
a: व्यसनं — 1 Casting away, dispelling. --2 Separating, dividing. --3 Violation, infraction. --4 Loss, destruction, defeat, fall; defection, weak point; अमात्यव्यसनं Pt. 3; स्वबलव्यसने Ki. 13. 15; Śi. 2. 57. --5 (a) A calamity, misfortune, distress, evil, disaster' ill-luck; अज्ञातभर्तृव्यसना मुहूर्तं कृतोपकारेव रतिर्बभूव Ku. 3. 73, 4. 30; R. 12. 57. (b) Adversity’ need; स सुहृद् व्यसने यः स्यात् Pt. 1. 337 ‘a friend in need is a friend indeed’. --6 Setting (as of the sun &c.); तेजोद्वयस्य युगपद्व्यसनोदयाभ्यां Ś. 4. 1 (where व्यसन means ‘a fall’ also). --7 Vice, bad practice, evil habit; मिथ्यैव व्यसनं वदंति मृगयामीदृग् विनोदः कुतः Ś. 2. 5, R. 18. 14; Y. 1. 310; (these vices are usually said to be ten; see Ms. 7. 47-48); समानशीलव्यसनेषु सख्यं Subhāṣ. --8 Close or intent application, assiduous devotion; विद्यायां व्यसनं Bh. 2. 62, 63. --9 Inordinate addiction. --10 Crime, sin. --11 Punishment. --12 Inability, incompetency. --13 Fruitless effort. --14 Air, wind. --15 Individuality. --Comp. --अतिभारः heavy calamity or distress; R. 14. 68. --अन्वित, --आर्त, --पीडित a. overtaken by calamity, involved in distress. --प्रहरिन् a. {1} hurting, attacking, giving trouble. {2} striking (an enemy) in his weak point.

k.v: निर्यातनं वैरशुद्धौ दाने न्यासार्पणेऽपि च। व्यसनं विपदि भ्रंशे दोषे कामजकोपजे॥
निर्यातनं वैरशुद्धौ दाने न्यासार्पणेऽपि च। व्यसनं विपदि भ्रंशे दोषे कामजकोपजे॥
निर्यातनं वैरशुद्धौ दाने न्यासार्पणेऽपि च। व्यसनं विपदि भ्रंशे दोषे कामजकोपजे॥
निर्यातनं वैरशुद्धौ दाने न्यासार्पणेऽपि च। व्यसनं विपदि भ्रंशे दोषे कामजकोपजे॥

m: व्य्-असन—ब्रह्मचारिन् m. a companion of adversity, fellow-sufferer, Mudr.
व्य्-असन—काल m. time of need, Subh.
व्य्-असन—महार्णव m. a sea of troubles, Mṛcch.
व्य्-असन—प्राप्ति f. occurrence of calamity, Sāh.
व्य्-असन—प्रहारिन् mfn. inflicting calamity, giving trouble or pain, W.
व्य्-असन—प्रसारित-कर mfn. having the hand stretched forth for (inflicting) calamity, Hit.
व्य्-असन—रक्षिन् mfn. preserving from calamity, R.; Kathās.
व्य्-असन—संस्थित mfn. one who indulges in any whim or favourite fancy, Pañcat.
व्य्-असन—वागुरा f. the net or snare of adversity, R.
व्य्-असन—वत् mfn. one who has had ill-luck with (comp.), Kām.
व्यसनि in comp. for व्यसनिन्.

v: tri॰ vyasanamasyAsti ini । 1 vyasanayukte kAmajAdimadyapAnAdirUpadozayukte 2 dEvAdyupadrute ca hemaca॰ ।
m: व्यसनिन् mfn. working hard, taking great pains, MBh.
(ifc.) passionately addicted to, fond of Kāv.; Kathās.
addicted to any kind of vice or evil practice (as gaming, drinking &c.), vicious, dissolute, Yājñ.; Hariv.; Kāv.
having a favourite pursuit or occupation, Śaṃk.
calamitous, unfortunate, unlucky with, suffering through or from (comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: व्यसनिन् — a. 1 Addicted to any vice, vicious. --2 Unlucky, unfortunate. --3 Intently attached or excessively devoted to anything, fond of (usually in comp.); किं भूमृत्कटकस्थितिव्यसनिना व्यर्थं खुराः शातिताः Subhāṣ.

m: व्यसनि—ता f. devotion or attachment to (loc. or comp.), fancy for, Kāv.; Hit.
an evil passion, Kathās.
व्यसनि—त्व n. (ifc.) attachment or addiction to, Rājat.
व्य्-अस˚नोदय m. the rising or approaching of misfortune, Pañcat.
व्य्-अस˚नोदय mfn. followed by or resulting in calamities, MBh.
व्य्-अस˚नोत्सव m. a feast for the (evil) passions, an orgy &c., VarBṛS.
व्य्—असि mfn. swordless, VarYogay.
व्य्-असि , व्य्-असु &c. See p. 1028, col. 3.
व्यस्तार m. (said to be fr. व्यस्त + आर fr. √ 4. ऋ; but rather formed in analogy to वि-स्तार, fr. √ स्तृ) the issue of the fluid from the temples of an elephant in rut, L.
a: व्यस्तारः — The issue of rut or ichor from the temples of an elephant.

s: (vi + as + ktaH .) vyAkulaH । vyAptaH । iti medinI ॥ pratyekam । pfTak pfTak । yaTA, viSvAmitraH । “kfcCracAndrAyaRAdini SudDyaByudayakAraRam । prakASe ca rahasye ca saMSaye'nuktake'sPuwe ॥ prAjApatyaH sAntapanaH SiSukfcCraH parAkakaH । atikfcCraH parRakfcCraH sOmyaH kfcCrAtikfcCrakaH ॥ mahAsAntapanaH SudDyE taptakfcCrastu pAvanaH । jalopavAsakfcCrastu brahmakUrccastu SoDakaH ॥ ete vyastAH samastA vA pratyekamekaSo'pi vA । pAtakAdizu sarvvezu pAtakezu prayatnataH । kAryyAScAndrAyaREryuktAH kevalA vA viSudDaye ॥” iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥ viparItaH । yaTA, -- “pratipadApyamAvAsyA tiTyoryugmaM mahAPalam । etadvyastaM mahAGoraM hanti puRyaM purAkftam ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
v: tri॰ vi + asa--kta। 1 vyAkule 2 vyApte medi॰ 3 viBakte ca “vyastarAtriMdivasya te” kumAraH । 4 viparIte “etadvyastaM mahAGoram” ti॰ ta॰ । “vyastaviDirvilome” lIlA॰ 5 sasuditapadArTamaDye ekEkasmin । “ete vyastA samastA vA” viSvAmitraH । 6 samastaBinne ca BAve kta । 7 vyatikrame tri॰
m: व्य्-अस्त mfn. cut in pieces, dismembered (said of Vṛtra), RV. i, 32, 7 torn asunder, gaping, TPrāt.
severed, separated, divided, distinct (व्य्-अस्ते काले, ‘at different times’, ‘now and then’), single, simple, Mn.; MBh. &c.
multiplied, various, manifold, Prab.; Kāvyād.
opposed to, inverse, reverse (see comp.)
disordered, disarranged, confused, bewildered (see comp.)
scattered, dispersed, Jyot.; Uttarar.
expelled, removed, Megh.
spread, extended (see comp.)
changed, altered (see comp.)
inherent in or pervading all the several parts of anything (in phil. opp. to सम्-अस्त), penetrated, pervaded
a: व्यस्त — p. p. 1 Cast or thrown asunder, tossed about; Māl. 5. 23. --2 Dispersed, scattered; U. 5. 14. --3 Dispelled, cast away. --4 Separated, divided, severed; हिमवति जलधौ च व्यस्ततोयेव गंगा V. 5. 22. --5 Taken or considered separately, taken singly (opp. समस्त); एभिः समस्तैरपि किमस्य किं पुतर्व्यस्तैः U. 5; तदस्ति किं व्यस्तमपि त्रिलोचने Ku. 5. 72. --6 Simple, uncompounded (as a word). --7 Manifold, different. --8 Removed, expelled. --9 Agitated, troubled, confused. --10 Disordered, out of order, disarranged. --11 Reversed, upset. --12 Inverse (as ratio). --13 Pervading, inherent in. --स्तं ind. Severally, separately, singly. --Comp. --केश a. with disordered or dishevelled hair. --त्रैराशिकं the rule of three inverted. --पदं {1} (in law) a confused statement (of a case). {2} an uncompounded or simple word. --वृत्ति a. the meaning of which is changed, which has lost its force (as a word); R. 11. 73.

k.v: ऋजावजिह्मप्रगुणौ व्यस्ते त्वप्रगुणाकुलौ। शाश्वतस्तु ध्रुवो नित्यसदातनसनातनाः॥

m: व्य्-अस्त—केश mf(ई)n. having dishevelled hair, AV.
व्य्-अस्तम् (अम्), ind. severally, separately, partially, MW.
व्य्-अस्त—न्यास mfn. ‘having separate impressions’, rumpled (as a couch), Ratnāv. ii, 11

s: klI, (vyastaM padaM yasmin .) fRAdAnABiyoge padAntareRottaram । yaTA । suvarRaSatABiyoge anenAhantAqita iti । iti mitAkzarA ॥
m: व्य्-अस्त—पद n. confused statement of a case (in a law-court; as, when a man is accused of debt, it is stated in defence that he has been assaulted), counter-plaint, Yājñ., Sch.
(in gram.) a simple or uncompounded word, W.
व्य्-अस्त—पुच्छ mfn. having an extended tail, Śulbas.
व्य्-अस्त—रात्रिं-दिव mfn. dividing or separating night and day, MW.
व्य्-अस्त—ता f. severalty, individuality, W.
individual inherence, ib.
agitation, bewilderment, ib.
व्य्-अस्त—त्रैराशिक n. the rule of three inverted, Col.
व्य्-अस्त—त्व n. severalty, individuality, W.
individual inherence, ib.
agitation, bewilderment, ib.
व्य्-अस्त—वृत्ति mfn. (a word) whose proper force or meaning is changed or altered, Ragh. xi, 73.
व्य्-अस्त—विधि m. inverted rule, any rule for inversion, Col.
व्य्-अस्तिका ind. with arms or legs spread asunder, Mahāvy.
व्य्-अस्तिका—कृत mfn. being in the above position, ib.

v: tri॰ vigatAH asavo yasya । 1 mfte “Seze jAto BavedvyasuH” jyotizam ।
m: व्य्—असु mf(उ)n. lifeless, dead, MBh.; BhP.; Śiś.; Rājat.
a: व्यसु — a. Lifeless, dead; Śi. 20. 3.

m: व्य्—असु—त्व n. loss of life, VarBṛS.

व्य्-अती (अति-√ इ) P. -अत्येति, to pass away, elapse, MBh.; R. &c.; to take an irregular course, PañcavBr.; to depart or deviate or swerve from (abl.), R.; Ragh.; to go past or beyond or through (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to surpass, overcome, conquer, MBh.; to disregard, neglect, Bhag.
a: व्यती — {c2c} P. (व्यति-इ) 1 To go out of, swerve from, transgress; रेखामात्रमपि क्षुण्णादा मनोर्वर्त्मनः परं . न व्यतीयुः प्रजास्तस्य नियंतुर्नेमिवृत्तयः .. R. 1. 17. --2 To pass, elapse (as time); सप्त व्यतीयुस्त्रिगुणानि तस्य (दिनानि) R. 2. 25; व्यतीते काले &c --3 To pass beyond, leave behind; यं यं व्यतीयाय पतिंवरा सा R. 6. 67. --4 To surpass, excel. --5 To neglect, omit.

m: व्य्-अतीहा f. (fr. व्य्-अति-√ ईह्), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 43, Vārtt. 4.

s: puM, (vi + ati + hf + GaY । “upasargasya GaYIti .” 6 । 3 । 122 । iti dIrGaH .) parIvarttaH । iti jawADaraH ॥ parasparamekajAtIyakriyAkaraRam । yaTA, keSAkeSi । daRqAdaRqi । ityAdi । iti vyAkaraRam ॥
m: व्य्-अतीहार m. = व्य्-अतिहार, q.v.
व्य्-अती-कार m. = 1. व्य्-अतिकर, contact, hostile encounter, Hariv.
व्य्-अतीक्षा f. (व्य्-अति-ईक्षा), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 43, Vārtt. 4.

s: puM, (vi + ati + pata + GaY । “upasargasya GaYIti .” 6 । 3 । 122 । iti upasargasya dIrGaH .) mahotpAtaH । apayAnam । iti medinI ॥ vizkamBAdisaptaviMSatiyogAntargatasaptadaSayogaH । tatra sarvvakarmmavarjanaM yaTA, -- “niraMSaM divasaM vizwiM vyatIpAtaYca vEDftim । kendraM vApi SuBErhInaM pApAhamapi varjayet ॥ pariGasya tyajedardDaM SuBakarmma tataH param । gaRqavyAGAtayoH zaw ca nava harzaRavajrayoH । vEDftivyatipAtO ca samastO parivarjayet ॥” * ॥ asya pratiprasavamAha BImaparAkrame । “na vizkamBo navA gaRqo na vyatIpAtavaDftI । candratArAbale prApte dozA gacCantyasaMmuKAH ॥ navamyaNgArako vizwiH SanEScaradinaM taTA । vyatIpAto na dUzyecca yasyArko dakziRe sTitaH ॥ yadi vizwivyatIpAtO dinaM vApyaSuBaM Bavet । hanyate'mftayogena BAskareRa tamo yaTA ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥ * ॥ tatra jAtaPalam । “kaWoravAkyaH piSunasvaBAvo gadAturo mAtfhito manuzyaH । parasya kAryye kftapakzapAto yasya prasUtO vyatipAtayogaH ॥” iti kozWIpradIpaH ॥ pAriBAzikayogaviSezaH । yaTA, bfhanmanuH । “SravaRASviDanizWArdrAnAgadEvatamastake । yadyamA ravivAreRa vyatIpAtaH sa ucyate ॥” tatra gaNgAsnAnaPalaM yaTA । brahmARqe । “saMkrAntizu vyatIpAte grahaRe candrasUryyayoH । puzye snAtvA tu jAhravyAM kulakowIH samudDaret ॥” iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥ (yaTA ca BAgavate । 4 । 12 । 48 । “dinakzaye vyatIpAte saMkrame'rkadine'pi vA । SrAvayet SraddaDAnAnAM tIrTapAdapriyASrayaH ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + ati + pata--GaY dIrGaH । 1 mahotpAtaBede 2 apamAne medi॰ vizkamBAdizu maDye 3 yogaBede jyo॰ ta॰ “SravaRASviDanizWArdrAnAgadEvatamastake । yadyamA ravivAreRa vyatIpAtaH sa ucyate” vfdDamamUkte 4 tiTyAdiyogaBede ca pAtaSabde 4297 pf॰ darSite rasi॰ ukte krAntisAvyAtmake yAgaviyogarUpe 5 vAhnaBede “vyatIpAtatrayaM DAraM gaRqAntatritaya taTA । etad BasanDitritayaM savakarmasu varjayet” sU॰ si॰ “vyatIpAtAnAM trayaM yogaviyogAtmako krAntilAmbarUpO dvO vyatIpAtO vizuvatsanniDO krAntisAmyAntareRa vyatIpAtastaboreva BedaH na pfTak । paScANgAntargatayogAntargata vyatIpAtaSceti trayam” raNga॰ । Bavizyapu॰ “caturdaSyAM yadA yogo vyatIpAtena cArdrayA । tadA puRyatamaH kAlo devAnAmapi durlaBaH । tadA yaH snAti gaNgAyAM BaktyA tat PalamApnuyAt । yatra tatra vipanno hi maNgAmaraRajantu saH” prA॰ ta॰ ukte 6 tiTyAdiyogaBede । “niraMSaM divasaM vizwiM vyatIpAtaYca vEDftim । kendraM vApi SuBErhInaM pApAhamapi vajayet । pariGasya tyajedardDaM SuBakarma tataHparam । gaRqavyAGAtayoH zaw ca nava hazaRavajrayoH । vEDfti vyatIpAtO ca samastaM parivarjayet” । asya pratiprasavamAha BImaparAkrame “na vizkamBo na vA gaRqo na vyatAzAtavEDftI । candratArAbale prApte dozAgacCantyasaMmuKA । navamyaNgArako vizwiH SanEcaradinaM taTA । vyatIpAto na duzyecca yasyArko dakziRe sTitaH । yadi vizwivyatApAtA dina vApyaSuBaM uvet । hanyate'mftayIgena BAskareRa tamo yaTA” jyo॰ ta॰ ।
m: व्य्-अती-पात m. = व्य्-अति-पात, Āryabh. (here also = वैधृत), Hcat.
a great calamity or any portent indicating it, L.
disrespect, contempt, W.
the day of new moon (when it falls on Ravi-vāra or Sunday, and when the moon is in certain Nakṣatras), ib.
a: व्यतीपातः — 1 Total departure, complete deviation. --2 Any great portentous calamity, or a portent foreboding a great calamity. --3 Disrespect, contempt. --4 The seventeenth of the astronomical Yogas. --5 The day of full-moon (when it falls on a Monday). --6 A malignant or evil aspect of the sun and moon (considered to be inauspicious for the performance of any action).

s: tri, (vi + ati + i + ktaH .) atItaH । gataH । yaTA, -- “ardDarAtre vyatIte tu saMkrAntiryadaharBavet । pUrvve vratAdikaM kuryyuH paredyuH snAnadAnayoH ॥ iti tiTitattve BImaparAkramIyam ॥
v: tri॰ vi + ati + iR--kta । atAte “vyatItakAlastvahamaByupetaH” iti raGuH ।
m: व्यतीत mfn. passed away, gone, Mn.; MBh. &c.
departed, dead, MBh.
left, abandoned, Prab.
(ifc.) having disregarded or neglected, R.
tardy, negligent, ib.
a: व्यतीत — p. p. 1 Passed, gone, elapsed, passed over; R. 5. 14. --2 Dead. --3 Left, abandoned, departed from. --4 Disregarded, omitted.

m: व्यतीत—काल mfn. one whose time is past, unseasonable, inopportune, Ragh.
व्य्-अति m. (fr. 3. वि and √ 2. अत्; but not dissolved in Padap.) a horse, RV.
व्य्-अति-√ भा Ā. -भाते (pf. -बभे), to shine forth fully or brightly (used impers.), Viddh.
व्य्-अति-√ भू Ā. -भवते (3. sg. prec. -भविषीष्ट, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 88, Sch.), to vie with any one (acc.), contend for precedence or superiority, Vop.
व्य्-अतिभेद m. bursting forth together or simultaneously, Sāh.
pervading, penetration, Nyāyas.
व्य्-अति-भिन्न mfn. (√ भिद्) inseparably joined or connected with, Nyāyas., Sch.
व्य्-अति-√ शॄ P. -शीर्यते (pr.p. -शीर्यत्), to burst into many pieces, MBh.
व्य्-अति-√ शी Ā. -शेते, to extend or pass beyond, surpass, Kāṭh.
व्य्-अति-शङ्कित mfn. (√ शङ्क्), ‘suspecting’ or ‘suspected’ (in मिथ्या-व्˚), Hariv.
व्य्-अति-˚चार See अ-व्यतिचार.
व्य्-अति-√ चर् (only 1. sg. pr. Ā. -चरे), to transgress against, offend (acc.), R.
व्य्-अति-चुम्बित mfn. (√ चुम्ब्) touched closely, in immediate contact with, Naiṣ.
व्य्-अति-√ गा P. -जिगाति (only aor. व्य्-अत्य्-अगात्), to pass by, Ragh.
व्य्-अति-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go against each other, Pāṇ. i, 3, 15, Sch.
व्य्-अति-˚गत mfn. passed by, elapsed (as time), MBh.

s: puM, (vi + ati + hf + GaY .) vinimayaH । yaTA, -- “paridAnaM vinimayo nEmeyaH parivarttanam । vyatihAraH parAvartto vEmeyo vimayo'pi ca ॥” iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 12 । 92 । “vikrama-vyatihAreRa sAmAnyABUddbayorapi । jayaSrIrantarAvedirmattavAraRayoriva ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + ati + hf--GaY vA dIrGaH । parIvartte hemaca॰ । 2 parasparEkajAtIyakriyAkaraRe ।
m: व्य्-अतिहार m. interchange, alternation, reciprocity, Pāṇ.; Vop.
exchange, barter, Kāṭh.
exchange of blows or abuse, W.
a: व्यति(ती)हारः — 1 Exchange, barter. --2 Reciprocity, interchange; R. 12. 93. --3 Exchange of blows, abuse, &c.

m: व्य्-अति-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to strike back or in return, MBh.; Bhaṭṭ.; to strike each other, fight together, Pāṇ. i, 3, 15 : to kill together, Pat.
व्य्-अति-√ हस् P. -हसति, to laugh at each other, Pāṇ. i, 3, 15, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
व्य्-अति-√ हृ Ā. -हरते (Vop.), to transpose mutually, Gobh.
व्य्-अति-√ हिंस् P. -हिंसति, to hurt or injure each other, Pāṇ. i, 3, 15, Sch.
व्य्-अति-√ जल्प् P. -जल्पति, to chatter together, gossip, Pāṇ. i, 3, 15, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
व्य्-अति-√ जि (only 3. sg. pf. Ā. -जिग्ये), to conquer, surpass, excel, Bhaṭṭ.
व्य्-अति-√ कॄ Pass. -कीर्यते, to be mixed or blended together, Śaṃk.
a: व्यतिकॄ — {c6c} P. To mix, blend, scatter (usually in pass.).

m: व्य्-अतिकीर्ण mfn. scattered about in different directions, MBh.
mixed together, confused, MW.
a: {{व्यतिकर्णि->व्यतिकीर्ण||20170110||ह्त्त्प्स्:गित्हुब्.चोम्सन्स्क्रित्-लेऌइचोन्छौण्णैछ्थीऔङ्शिस्सुएस्332,|}} — p. p. 1 Mixed or blended together. --2 United.

s: puM, (vi + ati + kf + ap .) vyasanam । (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 74 । 89 । “asmin vyatikare vftte SatrutAmeva te gataH ॥”) vyatizaNgaH । iti medinI ॥ (vinASaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 1 । 7 । 32 । “prajopadravamAlakzya lokavyatikaraYca tam । mataYca vAsudevasya saMjahArArjjuno dvayam ॥” miSraRam । yaTA, mAGe । 4 । 53 । “anyonyavyatikaracAruBirvicitrEratrasyannavamaRijanmaBirmayUKEH ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + ati--kF--ap । vyatisambanDe 2 vyasame ca medi॰ ।
m: 1. व्य्-अतिकर mfn. acting reciprocally, reciprocal, W.
व्य्-अतिकर m. reciprocity, reciprocal action or relation, ib.
contact, contiguity, union (ifc. = joined with, spreading through or over, pervading), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(ifc.) taking to, accomplishing, performing, Amar.; Daś.; Rājat.
incident, opportunity, Nalac.
reverse, misfortune, calamity, accident, fatality, Hcar.; Pañcat.; Kathās.
destruction, end, BhP.
2. व्य्-अतिकर m. mixing or blending together, mixture, MBh.; BhP.
a confusing (or striking) resemblance, Jātakam.
a: व्यतिकर — a. 1 Reciprocal. --2 Spreading, pervading. --3 Contiguous, near. --रः 1 Mixture, intermixture, mixing, blending together; तीर्थे तोयव्यतिकरभवे जह्नुकन्यासरय्वोः R. 8. 95; व्यतिकर इव भीमस्तामसो वैद्युतश्च U. 5. 13; Māl. 9. 52. --2 Contact, union, combination; रुद्रेणेदमुमाकृतव्यतिकरे स्वांगे विभक्तं द्विधा M. 1. 4; Māl. 7, Śi. 4. 53, 7. 28. --3 Striking against; Māl. 5. 34. --4 Obstruction; Ku. 5. 85. --5 An incident, occurrence, affair, a thing, matter; एवंविधे व्यतिकरे ‘such being the case.’ --6 An opportunity. --7 Misfortune, calamity. --8 Mutual relation, reciprocity. --9 Exchange, interchange. --10 Alternation.

m: 2. व्य्-अतिकर—वत् mfn. mixed, of contrary kind or nature, Mcar.
व्य्-अतिकरित mfn. mixed or joined with (instr. or comp.), Mcar.; Mālatīm.
a: व्यतिकरित — a. Pervaded, filled; Māl. 2. 9.

m: व्य्-अति-√ कृ only Pass. -क्रियते, to be greatly changed or moved, BhP.
व्य्-˚अतिकृत mfn. pervaded, MW.

a: व्यतिक्रांत — p. p. 1 Passed over, transgressed, violated, neglected. --2 Inverted, reversed. --3 Elapsed, passed away (as time).

m: व्य्-अति-˚क्रान्त mfn. passed over &c.
reversed, inverted, W.
one who has wrongly taken to (acc.), MBh. xii, 6492
व्य्-अति-˚क्रान्त n. transgression, sin, fault, R.
व्य्-अति-˚क्रान्ति f. (ifc.) committing a sin against, harming, wronging, Sāh.

व्य्-अति-√ क्रम् P. Ā. -क्रामति, -क्रमते (ind.p. -क्रम्य), to go or pass by, step over or beyond (lit. and fig.), MBh.; R.; Pañcat.; to pass away, elapse, be spent (as time), ib.; BhP.; to excel, surpass, conquer, R.; to neglect, omit, violate, ib.
a: व्यतिक्रम् — {c1c} U. 1 To transgress, violate, offend against; Pt. 1. 56. --2 To neglect, omit. --3 To pass, spend (time). --4 To pass over or beyond.

s: puM, (vi + ati + krama + GaY .) kramaviparyyayaH । yaTA, -- “sarvvatra prANmuKo dAtA grahItA ca udaNmuKaH । eza eva viDirdAne vivAhe ca vyatikramaH ॥” ityudbAhatattvam ॥
v: pu॰ vi + ati + krama--GaY na vfdDiH । 1 viparyyaye “vivAhe ca vyatikramaH” u॰ ta॰ । 2 viSezato'tikrame ca ।
m: व्य्-˚अतिक्रम m. going or passing by, Suśr.
gaining the start, MBh.
passing away, lapse (of time), R.
leaping or passing over, avoiding, escaping, getting rid of (gen.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
overstepping, transgressing, neglect, violation, non-performance, disregard of (gen. or comp.), Gaut.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
violation of established order, transgression, crime, vice, fault, sin against (gen. or comp.), Āpast.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
inverted order, reverse, contrary, ŚrS.; Daś.
a: व्यतिक्रमः — 1 Transgressing, deviating, swerving. --2 Violation, breach, non-performance; as in सांविद्व्यतिक्रमः; प्रतिबघ्नाति हि श्रेयः पूज्यपूजाव्यतिक्रमः R. 1. 79. --3 Disregard, neglect, omission. --4 Contrariety, inversion, reverse. --5 Sin, vice, crime. --6 Adversity, misfortune.

m: व्य्-˚अतिक्रमण n. (ifc.) committing a sin against, wronging, Kauś.
व्य्-˚अतिक्रमिन् mfn. (ifc.) sinning against, wronging, Āpast.
passing over, deviating, transgressing, MW.
व्य्-अति-क्षेप m. (क्षिप्) mutual exchange or permutation, Āpast.
mutual altercation, strife, contest, MBh. (v.l. व्य्-अधि-क्षेप).
व्य्-अति-√ लू Ā. -लुनीते (or P. -लुनाति, if joined with इतरेतरस्य, or अन्यो ऽन्यस्य), to cut mutually, Pāṇ. i, 3, 14; 16, Sch.
व्य्-अति-लङ्घिन् mfn. (√ लङ्घ्) falling or slipping away, Ragh.
व्य्-अति-मूढ mfn. (√ मुह्) excessively perplexed or embarrassed, utterly distracted, Hariv.

व्य्-अति-मर्श m. (√ मृश्) a partic. kind of Vihāra (mutual transposition of the several Pādas or half verses or whole verses of the first and second Vālakhilya hymns which are repeated in sets, two always taken together), MW.
व्य्-अति-मर्श्˚अम् ind. so as to encroach, ĀśvŚr.
so as to skip or take alternately, MW.
व्य्-अति-मिश्र mfn. mixed or confounded with one another, MBh.; VarBṛS.
व्य्-˚अतिमोह See अ-व्यतिमोह.
व्य्-अति-√ नी P. -नयति, to let pass (time), ĀśvŚr.
व्य्-अति-पाक m. (√ पच्), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 43, Vārtt. 1.

व्य्-अति-पात m. (√ पत्) N. of a partic. astronomical Yoga (when sun and moon are in the opposite Ayana and have the same declination, the sum of their longitudes being = 180 degrees), Var.; Hcat. &c. (cf. व्य्-अती-पात);
व्य्-अति-पात—जनन-शान्ति f. N. of wk.
व्य्-अति-पात—प्रकरण n. N. of wk.
व्य्-अति-पात—व्रत-कल्प m. N. of wk.
व्य्-अति-√ पठ् P. -पठति, to recite mutually, Pāṇ. i, 3, 15, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
व्य्-अति-√ रा Ā. -राते, Siddh. (व्यत्य्-अरे, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 64, Sch.)
व्य्-अतिरेचन n. contrasting, pointing out a contrast or difference (in a comparison), Sāh.
व्य्-अतिरे˚कालंकार m. the rhetorical figure called Vyatireka, ib.
व्य्-अतिरेकात् ind., with exception of, without
व्य्-अतिरे˚कावली f. N. of wk.

s: puM, (vi + ati + rica + GaY .) vinA । aBAvaH । yaTA । yadvyatirekajYAnaM yadutpattipratibanDakaM tat tanniScayasADyam । iti parAmarSagranTaH ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 39 । 166 । “na pativyatirekeRa sustrIRAmaparA gatiH ॥”) alaNkAraviSezaH । yaTA, -- “vyatireko viSezaScedupamAnopameyayoH । SElA ivonnatAH santu kintu prakftikomalAH ॥” iti candrAlokaH ॥
v: pu॰ vi + ati + rica--GaY । 1 viSezeRa atikrame 3 aBAve 4 vinevarTe 5 arTAlaNkAraBede ca alaNkAraSabde 404 pf॰ dfSyam। nyAyokte 6 tadasattve tadasattvarUpe kAraRatAjAhake padArTaBede kAvyABAvavyApakIBUtABAvapratiyogitvarUpe vyAptaBede ca ।
m: व्य्-अतिरेक m. distinction, difference, separateness, separation, exclusion, Lāṭy.; Kāv.; Pur. &c. (भावो व्यतिरेक-तस्, a separate or particular existence; वीत-व्यतिरेक, not separate or particular; ˚केण ind. or ˚कात् ind. [or व्यतिरेक ibc.], with exception of, without)
negation, Kap.
contrariety, contrast to (comp.), Kām. (˚के ind., on the contrary supposition)
logical discontinuance (opp. to अन्वय, q.v.), Bhāṣāp.
(in rhet.) a partic. figure of speech (the contrasting of things compared in some respects with each other), Kāvyād.; Sāh. &c.; N. of wk.
a: व्यतिरेकः — 1 Distinction, difference. --2 Separation from. --3 Exclusion, exception. --4 Excellence, surpassing, excelling. --5 Contrast, dissimilarity. --6 (In logic) Logical discontinuance (opp. अन्वय q. v.); यत्र साध्याभावस्तत्र हेत्वभाव इति व्यतिरेकव्याप्तिः (e. g. यत्र वह्निर्नास्ति तत्र धूमो नास्ति is an instance of व्यतिरेकव्याप्ति). --7 (In Rhet.) A figure of speech which consists in representing the Upameya as superior to the Upamāna in some particular respects; उपमानाद्यदन्यस्य व्यतिरेकः स एव सः K. P. 10. (व्यतिरेकेण means ‘except, without’; व्यतिरेके ‘on the contrary supposition.’). --Comp. --व्याप्ति see व्यतिरेक (6) above.

m: व्य्-अतिरेक—तस् ind. See above
व्य्-अतिरेक—व्याप्ति f. ‘pervasion of difference or dissimilitude’, a comprehensive argument derived from negation or nonexistence of certain qualities, MW.
व्य्-अतिरेके ind.,, on the contrary supposition
व्य्-अतिरेकेण ind., with exception of, without
व्य्-अतिरेकि in comp. for व्यतिरेकिन्
व्य्-˚अतिरेकि—लिङ्ग n. an exclusive mark, negative property (excluding its subject from the class possessing the corresponding positive property), MW.

v: na॰ vi + ati + rica--GimuR । nyAyokte bADyABAvavyApakIBUtABAvapatiyAgitvarUpavyAptihetuke 1 anumAnaBede “taccAnumAnaM triviDaM kevalAnvayikavalavyatitekyanvayavyatirekiBedAt” cintAmaRiH । yaTA pfTivI itaraBinnA ganDavattvAt ityAdi । vyatirekidfzwAntaSca yannEvaM tannEvamityAdi । 2 atikrAmake ca striyA NIp ।
m: व्य्-अतिरेकिन् mfn. distinguishing, excluding, excepting, negative, Tarkas.
different, reverse, W.
a: व्यतिरेकिन् — a. 1 Different. --2 Surpassing, excelling. --3 Excluding, excepting. --4 Showing negation or non-existence; as in व्यतिरोकिलिंगं; see व्यतिरेक (6) above.

m: व्य्-˚अतिरेकि—पूर्व-पक्ष-रहस्य n. N. of wk.
व्य्-˚अतिरेकि—रहस्य n. N. of wk.
व्य्-˚अतिरेकि—सिद्धान्त-रहस्य n. N. of wk.
व्य्-˚अतिरे˚क्य्-उदाहरण n. illustration by contrast or negation (of certain properties), W.
व्य्-अति-√ रिच् Pass. -रिच्यते, to reach far beyond, leave behind, surpass, excel (acc. or abl.), Hariv.; Ragh.; to be separated from (abl.), BhP.; to differ from, ib.; Śaṃk.
a: व्यतिरिच् — Pass. 1 To differ or be separate from. --2 To surpass, excel; lie beyond; स्तुतिभ्यो व्यतिरिच्यंते दूराणि चरितानि ते R. 10. 30. See व्यतिरिक्त below.

s: tri, vyatirekaviSizwaH । BinnaH । viati-pUrvvaricaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannametat ॥ (aDikaH । yaTA, kAtantracatuzwayasya praTamAviBaktirliNgArTavacane ityasya paYjI । “viSezeRAtirikto'Diko vyatiriktaH ॥”)
v: tri॰ vi + ati + rica--kta । Binne “na vfkzavfttivyatiriktasATanam” iti amAraH ।
m: व्य्-अतिरिक्त mfn. reaching beyond, excessive, immoderate (ifc. = abundantly furnished with), MBh.
separate, different or distinct from, other than (abl. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(ifc.) free from, Sarvad.
left remaining from, Ragh., Sch. (v.l.)
with drawn, withheld, W.
excepted, ib.
a: व्यतिरिक्त — p. p. 1 Separated or distinct from; अव्यतिरिक्तेयमस्मच्छरीरात् K., Ku. 1. 31, 5. 22. --2 Surpassing, excelling, going beyond. --3 Withdrawn, withheld. --4 Excepted --क्तं ind. With the exception of, except, without.

m: व्य्-अतिरिक्त्˚अक n. a partic. manner of flying, MBh.
व्य्-अतिरिक्तम् ind. with the exception of, except, without (e. g. स्वर-व्˚, ‘except the accent’), MW.
व्य्-अतिरिक्त—ता f. distinction, difference. (BhP.)
व्य्-अतिरिक्त—त्व n. distinction, difference. (Sarvad.)
व्य्-अतिरोपित mfn. (fr. Caus.) ejected, expelled, dispossessed, ib.
व्य्-अति-√ रुह् P. -रोहति, to grow, MBh.; to attain to (another state acc.), ib.
व्य्-अति-सं-√ दह् P. -दहति, to burn up entirely, ChUp.
व्य्-अति-√ सेव् Pass. -सेव्यते, to be well furnished or provided with (instr.), MBh. vii, 7297.
व्य्-अति-√ सृ only ind.p. -सृत्य, prob. ‘in each case’, ‘on every occasion’, MBh. xii, 4402 (गुरुम् अनु-सृत्य, Nīlak.) : Caus. -सारयति (with कथाम्), to converse, Divyāv.
व्य्-अति-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति (Pāṇ. i, 3, 15), to move to and fro, fly in every direction (as arrows), MBh.
व्य्-अति-√ तॄ (only 3. sg. P. -तरिष्यति), to pass completely across, overcome, Bhag.
व्य्-अति-√ तन् (only 3. du. impf. Ā. व्यत्य्-अतन्वाताम्), to vie with each other in extending or spreading out, Bhaṭṭ.
व्य्-अति-√ वह् Ā. -वहते, to bear mutually or reciprocally, Vop.
व्य्-अति-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते, to go over, pass through, R.; to escape, avoid, MBh.; to glide or pass away, elapse, ib.; R.; Hariv.; to depart from (abl.), leave, quit, abandon, R.
व्य्-अति-विद्ध mfn. (√ व्यध्) pierced, transfixed, MBh. (B.)
put through, entwined, Śiś.
व्य्-अति-√ व्रज् P. -व्रजति, to go past, Āpast.; to stride over, overstep, Pañcat. (v.l.)
व्य्-अति-√ या P. -याति, to go completely through, penetrate, pervade, R.; to pass by, flow on (as time), Hariv.
व्य्-अतियात mfn. gone by, elapsed, ib.
व्य्-अति-√ यु P. यौति (only 2. du. pr. -युतस्), to unite mutually, mix together, mingle, Bhaṭṭ.
a: व्यतियु — {c2c} P. To mix; अन्योन्यं स्म व्यतियुतः शब्दाञ् शब्दैस्तु भीषणान् Bk. 8. 6.
व्यतिषंगः — 1 Mutual relation, reciprocal connection. --2 Intermixture. --3 Union, junction in general. --4 Fastening or tying together.
व्यतिषंज् — {c1c} P. 1 To link together, connect mutually; व्यतिषजति पदार्थानांतरः कोऽपि हेतुः U. 6. 12. --2 To change (Atm.).

s: puM, (vi + ati + zaYja + GaY .) parasparamelanam । (yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 103 । 5 । “senayorvyatizaNgeRa jayaH sADAraRo'Bavat ॥” vinimayaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 5 । 13 । 13 । “anyonyavittavyatizaNgavfdDavErAnubanDo viharan miTaSca ॥”)
m: व्य्-अतिषङ्ग m. mutual connection, reciprocal junction or relation, PañcavBr.; KātyŚr.
entanglement, Śiś. v, 61
hostile encounter, MBh.
exchange, barter, BhP.
absorption, MW.
व्य्-अतिषङ्गम् ind. so as to join or connect mutually, ŚBr.
व्य्-अतिषङ्ग—वत् mfn. having mutual connection, connected, united, mixed, ib.
व्य्-अतिषङ्ग्˚इन् mfn. (ifc.) hanging or sitting on Śiś.

व्य्-अति-षञ्ज् (√ सन्ज्) P. Ā. -षजति, ˚ते, (P.) to join or unite in opposite places, connect mutually, intertwine, TBr.; Uttarar.; to implicate, involve in (a game), Daś.; (Ā.) to change, MW. : Pass. -षज्यते, to be mutually connected, ib.
व्य्-अतिषञ्जित mfn. = व्य्-अतिषक्त, Śiś., Sch.
व्य्-˚अतिषज्य ind. seizing each other by the hand, PañcavBr.

v: tri॰ vi + ati + sanja--kta । 1 milite 2 graTite ca
m: व्य्-अतिषक्त mfn. mutually connected or joined or related, intertwined, mixed together, TBr. &c. &c.
intermarried, intermarrying, MW.
a: व्यतिषक्त — p. p. 1 Mutually connected or related, linked or joined together. --2 Intermixed. --3 Inter marrying.

m: व्य्-अतिषिक्त mfn. separated, ĀpY.

s: puM, (vyatyasanamiti । vi + ati + as + GaY .) viparyyayaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, harivaMSe । 27 । 29 । “mAtrAsi vaYcitA Badre ! caruvyatyAsahetunA । Bavizyati hi puttraste krUrakarmmAtidAruRaH ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + ati + asa--GaY । viparyyaye amaraH ।
m: व्य्-अत्यास m. exchange, barter, Lāṭy.; MBh.
change, inverted order, reverse (एन and आत्, ‘invertedly, alternately’), VarBṛS.; Suśr.
a: व्यत्यासः — 1 Inverted position or order. --2 Opposition, contrariety.

k.v: स्याद्व्यत्यासो विपर्यासो व्यत्ययश्च विपर्यये। पर्ययोऽतिक्रमस्तस्मिन्नतिपात उपात्ययः॥

m: व्य्-अत्यास्˚अम् ind. alternating, alternately, ŚBr.; ŚrS.
having inverted, having placed crosswise, MW.
व्य्-अत्य्-√ ऊह् P. -ऊहति, to place or arrange differently, Kāṭh.
व्य्-अत्य्-√ अस् Ā. -अति-स्ते (1. sg. -अति-हे, 2. sg. -अति-से, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 50; 52), to be above, excel, surpass, Bhaṭṭ.
a: व्यत्यस् — {vI.v} {c2c} A. (व्यतिहे, व्यतिसे, व्यतिस्ते) To excel, surpass, be above or superior to, outweigh; अन्यो व्यतिस्ते तु ममापि धर्मः Bk. 2. 35. {vII.v} {c4c} P. To invert, reverse, change upside down; see व्यत्यस्त below.

m: व्य्-अत्य्-अस्त mfn. (√ 2. अस्) thrown or placed in an inverted position, reversed, inverted, W.
placed across or crosswise, crossed (as the hands), Mn. ii, 72
perverse, preposterous, Bhām.
a: व्यत्यस्त — p. p. 1 Reversed, inverted. --2 Contrary, opposite. --3 Incoherent; व्यत्यस्तं लपति Bv. 2. 84. --4 Crossed, placed crosswise; व्यत्यस्तपादः, व्यत्यस्तभुजः &c.

s: puM, (vyatyayanamiti । vi + ati + i + “erac .” 3 । 3 । 56 । ityac .) vyatikramaH । tatparyyAyaH । vyatyAsaH 2 viparyyAsaH 3 viparyyayaH 4 । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 7 । 10 । 44 । “parAvarezAM sTAnAnAM kAlena vyatyayo mahAn ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + ati + iR--ac । 1 vyatikrame 2 vizaryyaye ca amaraH ।
m: व्य्-अत्यय m. transposition, transmutation, change, reverse, inverted order, contrariety (with कर्मणाम्, inverted or reverse occupation; ए, in the opposite case; अम्, alternately; आत् and एन, against the usual rule rule or order), Lāṭy.; Yājñ.; Kāv. &c.
a: व्यत्ययः — 1 Passing over. --2 Opposition, contrariety. --3 Inverted order, inversion. --4 Interchange, transmutation. --5 Obstruction, hindrance; Pt. 4. 57.

puM, (vi + ava + hf + GaY .) vivAdaH । ityamaraH ॥ vfkzaBedaH । nyAyaH । paRaH । sTitiH । iti medinISabdaratnAvalyO ॥ * ॥ (karmma । kriyA । yaTA, -- “na kaScit kasyacinmitraM na kaScikasya cidripuH । vyavahAreRa jAyante mitrARi ripavastaTA ॥” yaTA ca raGuH । 3 । 62 । “taTApi SastravyavahAranizWure vipakzaBAve ciramasya tizWataH । tutoza vIryyAtiSayena vftrahA padaM hi sarvvatra guRErniDIyate ॥”) aTa vyavahAradarSanam । tatra yAjYavalkyaH । “smftyAcAravyapetena mArgeRAGarzitaH parEH । Avedayati cedrAjYi vyavahArapadaM hi tat ॥” smftisadAcAravahirBUtena vartmanA parErarTataH SarIrato vA pIqitaScedrAjani nivedayettadbyavahAradarSanasTAnam । cedityatra saditi mETilAH । Avedayati cedityanena svayaM vivAdotTApanaM rAjYA na karttavyamiti SUlapARimahAmahopADyAyAH । rAjYIti vyavahArapradarSakaparam । taTA ca bfhaspatiH । “rAjA kAryyARi saMpaSyet prAqvivAko'TavA dbijaH ॥” * ॥ prAqvivAkalakzaRamAha sa eva । “vivAde pfcCati praSnaM pratipannaM taTEva ca । priyapUrvvaM prAgvadati prAqvivAkastataH smftaH ॥” kAtyAyanaH । “vyavahArASritaM praSnaM pfcCati prAqiti sTitiH । vivecayati yastasmin prAqvivAkastataH smftaH ॥” arTinaM prati BAzA te kIdfSI pratyarTinaM prati ca tavApi kIdfSamuttaraM iti pfcCatIti prAw SrutvA ca yuktAyuktaMtvena jayaM parAjayaM vA vivinakti iti vivAkaH prAw ca sa vivAkaSceti prAqvivAkaH ॥ * ॥ kAtyAyanaH । “saprAqvivAkaH sAmAtyaH sabrAhmaRapurohitaH । svayaM sa rAjA cinuyAttezAM jayaparAjayO ॥ yadA kAryyavaSAdrAjA na paSyet kAryyanirRayam । tadA niyuYjyAdvidbAMsaM brAhmaRaM vedapAragam ॥ yadi vipro na vidbAn syAt kzattriyaM tatra yojayet । vESyaM vA DarmmaSAstrajYaM SUdraM yatnena varjjayet ॥” sa vinItaveSaH । manuH । “jAtimAtropajIvI vA kAmaM syAdbrAhmaRabruvaH । DarmmapravaktA nfpaterna tu SUdraH kadAcana ॥ nADyApayati nADIte sa brAhmaRabruvaH smftaH ॥” vyAsaH । “dbijAn vihAya yaH paSyet kAryyARi vfzalEH saha । tasya prakzuByate rAjyaM balaM kozaSca naSyati ॥ yaH SUdro vEdikaM DarmmaM smArttaM vA BAzate yadi । tasya daRqaM dbe sahasre sfknaRI cEva Bedayet ॥ duHSIlo'pi dvijaH pUjyo na SUdro vijitendriyaH । duzwAM gAM kaH parityajyArccayet SIlavatIM KarIm ॥” vyavahAramAha kAtyAyanaH । “vi nAnArTe'va sandehe haraRaM hAra ucyate । nAnAsandehaharaRAdvyavahAra iti sTitiH ॥” nAnAvivAdavizayaH saMSayo hriyate'nena iti vyavahAraH । BAzottarakriyAnirRAyakatvaM vyavahAratvam । taTA ca bfhaspatiH । “ajYAnatimiropetAn sandehapawalArdditAn । nirAmayAn yaH kurute SAstrAYjanaSalAkayA ॥ iha kIrttiM rAjapUjAM laBate sadgatiYca saH । tasmAt saMSayamUQAnAM karttavyaSca vinirRayaH ॥” ataeva nAradaH । “aniyukto niyukto vA SAstrajYo vaktumarhati । dEvIM vAcaM sa vadati yaH SAstramupajIvati ॥” dEvIM devAnumatAm ॥ * ॥ DarmmaSAstrayostu viroDe lokavyavahAra evAdaraRIyaH । ityAha sa eva । “DarmmaSAstraviroDe tu yuktiyukto viDi smftaH । vyavahAro'pi balavAn DarmmastenAvahIyate ॥” avahIyate avagamyate hi gatAvityasmAdDAtoH । ataeva bfhaspatiH । “kevalaM SAsstramASritya na karttavyo vinirRayaH । yuktihInavicAre tu DarmmahAniH prajAyate ॥” yuktirnyAyaH । sa ca lokavyavahAra iti vyavahAramAtfkA ॥ ataeva kAtyAyanaH । “kulaSIlavayovfttavittavadBiraDizWitam । baRigBiH syAt katipayEH kulavfdDEraDizWitam ॥” sada iti SezaH । kAtyAyanaH । “saByenAvaSyavaktavyaM DarmmArTasahitaM vacaH । SfRoti yadi no rAjA syAttu saByastadAnfRaH ॥” saByaH saBAyAM sADuH ॥ * ॥ taTAviDAnAha yAjYavalkyaH । “SrutADyayanasampannAH kulInAH satyavAdinaH । rAjYA saBAsadaH kAryyAH SatrO mitre ca ye samAH ॥” SrutADyayanasampannAH DarmmaSAstrajYAH । kulInAH saNkarAdidozaSUnyamAtApitfvaMSaparamparAkAH । evaMBUtAH saBAsadaH saBAyAM yaTA sIdanti upaviSanti taTA dAnamAnasatkArEH rAjYA karttavyAH ॥ * ॥ taTAviDAvasTAnena BUmeH saBAtvamAha manuH । “yasmin deSe nizIdanti viprA vedavidastrayaH । rAjYaH pratikfto vidbAn brAhmaRastAM saBAM viduH ॥” vidvatsahatAvapi saBAparyyAyaparizacCabdamAha sa eva । “trEvidyo hEtukastakIM nirukto DarmmapAWakaH । trayaScASramiRaH pUrvve parizat syAddaSAvarAH ॥” trEvidyaH trivedapAragaH । hEtukaH । a: व्यवहारः — 1 Conduct, behaviour, action. --2 Affair, business, work. --3 Profession, occupation. --4 Dealing, transaction. --5 Commerce, trade, traffic. --6 Dealing in money, usury. --7 Usage, custom, an established rule or practice. --8 Relation, connection; Pt. 1. 79. --9 Judicial procedure, trial or investigation of a case, administration of justice; व्यवहारस्तमाह्वयति; अलं लज्जया व्यवहारस्त्वां पृच्छति Mk. 9. --10 A legal dispute, complaint, suit, law-suit, litigation; व्यवहारोऽयं चारुदत्तप्तवलंबते, इति लिख्यतां व्यवहारस्य प्रथमः पा दः, केन सह मम व्यवहारः Mk. 9; R. 17. 39. --11 A title of legal procedure, any occasion of litigation. --Comp. --अंगं the body of civil and criminal law. --अभिशस्त a. prosecuted, charged. --अयग्येः a minor (in law). --आसनं the tribunal of justice, judgment-seat; व्यवहारासनमाददे युवा R. 8. 18. --ज्ञः {1} one who understands business. {2} a youth come of age, one who is no longer a minor. {3} one who is acquainted with judicial procedure. --तंत्रं course of conduct; वाक्प्रतिष्ठानिबंधनानि देहिनां व्यवहारतत्रांणि Māl. 4. --दर्शनं trial, judicial investigation. --पदं = व्यवहारविषय q. v. --पादः {1} any one of the four stages of a legal proceeding; these are four: --(1) पूर्वपक्ष, the plaint; (2) उत्तरपक्ष the defence; (3) क्रियापाद adducing evidence, oral or written; (4) निर्णयपाद, the decision or verdict. {2} the fourth stage; i. e. निर्णयपाद, that part which concerns the verdict or decision. --मातृका {1} a legal process in general. {2} any act or subject relating to the administration of justice or formation of courts (of which thirty heads are enumerated). --विधिः a rule of law, any code of law. --विषयः (so --पदं, --मार्गः, --स्थानं) a subject or head of legal procedure, an actionable business, a matter which may be made the subject of litigation (these are eighteen; for an enumeration of their names, see Ms. 8. 4-7). --स्थितिः f. judicial procedure.

a: व्यवहृ — {c1c} P. 1 To deal in any transaction or business. --2 To act, behave, deal with (with loc. or by itself); कथं कार्यविनिमयेत व्यवहरति मय्यनात्मज्ञः M. 1; बहिःसर्वाकारप्रगुणरमणीयं व्यवहरन् Māl. 1. 14. --3 To go to law, sue (one) in a court of law; अर्थपतिर्व्यवहर्तुमर्थगौरवादभियोक्ष्यते Dk. --4 To manage, transact business; U. 1. 5. --5 To regain, recover. --6 To distinguish.

m: व्य्-अवहृत् mfn. dealing in (ifc.), Kathās.
(as subst.) usage, practice, Harav.
व्य्-˚अवहृत mfn. practised, employed, used, MW.
व्य्-˚अवहृत n. commerce, intercourse, BhP.
व्य्-˚अवहृति f. practice, conduct, action, Rājat.; Sāh.
intercourse, Rājat.
business, trade, commerce, BhP.
litigation, lawsuit, Cat.
speech, talk, rumour (see दुर्-व्य्˚)
a: व्यवहृतिः — f. 1 Practice, process. --2 Action, performance.

m: व्य्-˚अवहृति—तत्त्व n. N. of a ch. of the Smṛti-tattva (cf. व्यवहार-त्˚).

s: tri, (vi + ava + DA + ktaH .) vyavaDAnaviSizwaH । yaTA, -- “karttfkarmmavyavahitAmasAkzAdDArayet kriyAm । upakurvvat kriyAsidDO SAstre'DikaraRaM matam ॥” iti mugDaboDawIkAyAM rAmatarkavAgISaH ॥
v: tri॰ vi + ava + DA--kta । vyavaDAnavati padArTe ।
m: व्य्-अवहित mfn. placed apart or asunder &c.
separated, not contiguous or immediately connected, Prāt.
interrupted, obstructed, disturbed, Śak.
screened from view, concealed, covered, Śaṃk.
hostile, opposed, BhP.
remote, distant, BhP.
passed over, surpassed, excelled, put to shame, W.
done, acted, performed, ib.
व्य्-अवहित See व्य्-अव-√ धा.
a: व्यवहित — p. p. 1 Placed apart. --2 Separated by anything intervening; Śi. 2. 85. --3 Interrupted, stopped, obstructed, impeded. --4 Screened from view, hidden, concealed. --5 Not immediately connected. --6 Done, performed. --7 Passed over, omitted. --8 Surpassed, excelled. --9 Hostile; opposed.
व्यवहित — See under व्यवधा.

m: व्य्-अवह्रियमाण mfn. being named or designated (-त्व n.), Kusum.
व्य्-अवह्रियमाण—त्व n.
व्य्-अव-√ कॄ P. -किरति, to scatter or pour down or on or about, BhP.
व्य्-˚अवकीर्ण mfn. intermixed or filled or set with (instr.), Kām.

s: klI, (vi + ava + kala + lyuw .) viyogaH । hInaH । aNkasyAntarakaraRam । vAkikAwA iti BAzA । yaTA, -- “aye bAle lIlAvati ! matimati ! brUhi sahitAn dvipaYcadvAtriMSattrinavatiSatAzwAdaSadaSa । SatopetAnetAnayutaviyutAMScApi vada me yadi vyakteryuktivyavakalanamArge'si kuSalA ॥” iti lIlAvatI ॥
v: na॰ vi + ava--kala--lyuw । 1 viyojane hemaca॰ 2 vigamane 3 hInatAsampAdane ca “vyavakalanamArge'si । kuSalA” lIlA॰ ।
m: व्य्-अव-कलन n. (√ 2. कल्) separation, subtraction, deduction, Col.
a: व्यवकलनं — 1 Separation. --2 (In math.) Subtraction, deduction ( व्यवकलितं also in this sense).

s: tri, (vi + ava + kala + ktaH .) kftavyavakalanaH । viyogitaH । hInitaH । vyavakalane, klI । yaTA । aTa saNkalitavyavakalitayoH karaRasUtraM vfttArdDam । “kAryyaM kramAdyutkramato'TavANkayogo yaTAsTAnakamantaraM vA ॥” iti lIlAvatI ॥
m: व्य्-अव—˚कलित mfn. subtracted, deducted, Līl.
व्य्-अव—˚कलित n. subtraction, deduction, ib.
व्य्-अव-√ कृष् P. -कर्षति, to draw or tear away, alienate, MBh. (v.l. व्य्-अप-क्˚).
व्य्-˚अवकिरणा f. mixing together, mixture, L.
व्य्-अव-क्रोशन n. (√ क्रुश्) mutual altercation or abuse, W.
abuse, reviling (in general), ib.
a: व्यवक्रोशनं — 1 Wrangling, mutual abuse. --2 Abuse in general.

m: व्य्-अव-√ ली Ā. -लीयते, to recline, lie or cower down, MBh.; Hariv.
व्य्-अव-लम्बिन् See अ-व्य्˚.
व्य्-अव-लोकन n. (√ लोक्) the act of taking a view of Divyāv.
व्य्-˚अवलोकित mfn. looked upon, viewed, beheld, ib.
व्य्-अव-√ मुच् (only ind.p. -मुच्य), to unloose, unfasten, take off, R.
व्य्-अव-√ नी (only ind.p. -नीय), to pour in separately, ŚBr.
व्यवन (a word used to explain व्योमन्), Nir. xi, 40.
व्य्-अव-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते, to fall down or asunder, ŚBr.
व्य्-अव-√ रुह् P. Ā. -रोहति, ˚ते, to ascend, mount, get upon (acc.), MBh. : Caus. -रोपयति (Pass. -रोप्यते; p.p. -रोपित), to displace, remove, deprive of (abl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
व्य्-अवसा˚यात्मक mfn. full of resolve or energy, energetic, laborious, MBh.

s: [n] tri, (vyavasAyo'syAstIti । iniH .) vyavasAyaviSizwaH । bARijyakArakaH । yaTA, -- “ko'tiBAraH samarTAnAM kiM dUraM vyavasAyinAm । ko videSaH savidyAnAM kaHparaH priyavAdinAm ॥” iti cARakyaSatakam ॥ anuzWAtA । yaTA, -- “ajYeByo granTinaH SrezWA granTiByo DAriRo varAH । DAriByo jYAninaH SrezWA jYAniByo vyavasAyinaH ॥” iti mAnave 12 aDyAyaH ॥ ajYeBya iti । uBayoH praSasyatve sati anyatarasyAtiSayavi kzayA SrezWatetIzwinobiDAnAdIzadaDyayanA ajYAH teByaH samagragranTADyetAraH SrezWAH । teByo'DItagranTaDAraRasamarTAH SrezWAH । tena granTinaH paTitavismftagranTA bodDavyAH । DAriByo'DItagranTArTajYAH prakfzwAH । teByo'nuzWAtAraH । iti tawwIkAyAM kullUkaBawwaH ॥

puM, (vi + ava + so + GaY .) upajovikA । peSA iti pArasyaBAzA । yaTA, -- “karoti nAma nItijYo vyavasAyamitastataH । PalaM punastadeva syAdyadviDermanasi sTitam ॥” iti hitopadeSe 2 paricCedaH ॥ api ca । “AhAro dviguRaH strIRAM budDistAsAM caturguRA । zaqguRo vyavasAyaSca kAmaScAzwaguRaH smftaH ॥” iti cARakyaSatakam ॥ anuzWAnam । iti vyavasAyiSabdArTadarSanAt ॥ (yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 2 । 30 । 41 । “sarvvaTA sadfSaM sIte ! mama svasya kulasya ca । vyavasAyamanukrAntA kAnte ! tvamatiSoBanam ॥”) niScayaH । yaTA, -- “byavasAyAtmikA budDirekeha kurunandana । bahuSAKA hyanantASca budDayo'vyavasAyinAm ॥” iti BagavadgItAyAm 2 aDyAyaH ॥ vyavasAyAtmiketi । iha ISvarArADanalakzaRe karmmayoge vyavaRAyAtmikA parameSvaraBaktyEka DruvaM tarizyAmIti niYcayAtmikA ekEva ekanizWEva budDirBavati । avyabasAyinAmISvarArADanabahirmuKAnAM kAminAM kAmanAnantyAdanantAstatrApi karmmaPala-guRaPalatvAdi-prakAraBedAdbahuSAKASca budDayo Bavanti । iti tawwIkAyAM svAmI ॥ vizRuH । yaTA, -- “vyavasAyo vyavasTAnaH saMsTAnaH sTAnado DruvaH ॥” iti mahABArate tasya sahasranAmastotre । 13 । 149 । 55 ॥ (mahAdevaH । yaTA, tatrEva । 13 । 17 । 50 । “sahasrahasto vijayo vyavasAyo hyatandritaH ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + ava + so--GaY । 1 udyame “maraRavyavamAyabudDim” kumAraH । 3 upajIvikAyAm 3 anuzWAne 4 avaDAraRe ca “vyavasAyAtmikA budDiH” gItA । 5 vizRO vizRusa॰ ।
m: व्य्-अवसाय See col. 3.
व्य्-अवसाय m. strenuous effort or exertion, Car.
settled determination, resolve, purpose, intention to (loc., acc. with प्रति, or comp.; ˚यम्√ कृ to make up one's mind, resolve, determine), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
Resolution (personified), R.; Pur.
trade, business, Campak.
an act, action, performance, R.
first impression or perception, Nīlak.
state, condition, MBh.
artifice, stratagem, trick, W.
boasting, ib.
N. of Viṣṇu, MW.
of Śiva, ib.
of a son of Dharma by Vapus (daughter of Dakṣa), ib.
a: व्यवसायः — 1 Effort, exertion, energy, industry, perseverance; करोतु नाम नीतिज्ञो व्यवसायमितस्ततः H. 2. 14. --2 Resolve, resolution, determination; मंदीचकार मरणव्यवसायबुद्धिं Ku. 4. 45 ‘the thought of resolving to die’; Bg. 2. 41, 10. 36. --3 An act, action, performance; व्यवसायः प्रतिपत्तिनिष्टुरः R. 8. 65. --4 (a) Business, employment, trade. (b) Following a particular profession or trade. --5 Conduct, behaviour. --6 Device, stratagem, artifice. --7 Boasting. --8 N. of Viṣṇu. --9 Of Śiva.

m: व्य्-अवसाय—बुद्धि mfn. having a resolute mind, ib.
व्य्-अवसाय—द्वितीय mfn. doubled or attended by (i.e. possessing) resolution, BhP.
व्य्-अवसाय—वर्तिन् mfn. acting resolutely, resolute, Kām.
व्य्-अवसाय—वत् mfn. full of resoluteness or perseverance, MBh.; Hariv.
व्य्-˚अवसायिन् mfn. one who acts resolutely or energetically, resolute, energetic, enterprising, industrious, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
engaged in trade or business, MW.
व्य्-˚अवसायिन् m. a tradesman, handicraftsman, ib.
a: व्यवसायिन् — a. 1 Energetic, industrious, diligent; Pt. 2. 51. --2 Resolute. persevering; Pt. 1. 248. --3 Performing, doing, undertaking. --4 Engaged in any business or profession. --m. A tradesman, merchant.

s: strI, (vi + ava + sTA + “AtaScopasarge .” ityaN । tatazwAp .) SAstranirUpitaviDiH । yaTA, -- “dIrGakAlaM brahmacaryyaM DAraRaYca kamaRqaloH । devareRa sutotpattirdattakanyA pradIyate ॥” ityAdInyaBiDAya ॥ “etAni lokaguptyarTaM kalerAdO mahAtmaBiH । nivarttitAni karmmARi vyavasTApUrvvakaM buDEH ॥” ityudvAhatattve hemAdriparASaraBAzyayorAdipurARam ॥ (niyamaH । yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 109 । 71 । “evaM kftaguhArakzo mahAratnAni SaNkaraH । utpAdya BagavAMstatra vyavasTAmAdideSa saH ॥”)

m: व्य्-अव-√ स्था Ā. -तिष्ठते, to go apart, separate from (abl.), ŚāṅkhŚr.; to differ respectively, Śaṃk.; to halt, stop, stay, R.; to prepare or make ready for (dat.), ib.; to be settled, be (logically) true or tenable, MBh.; Sarvad.; to appear as (nom.), Nir.; Sāṃkhyak. : Caus. -स्थापयति, to put down, place, VarBṛS.; Vās.; to fix on, direct towards (loc.), Kum.; to charge with, appoint to (अर्थम्), Hit.; to stop, hold up, prevent from falling, MBh.; Rājat.; to restore, re-establish, Kum.; Jātakam.; to settle, arrange, establish, determine, prove to be (logically) tenable, Daś.; Sarvad.; to give a name, Divyāv.; to perform, MW.
व्य्-अवस्था f. respective difference (आयाम् loc. in each single case), ŚrS.; Kap.; Śaṃk.
abiding in one place, steadiness, Kathās.
fixity, perseverance, constancy, MBh.; R. &c.
a fixed limit, Śiś.
settlement, establishment, decision, statute, law, rule (˚अया, instr. according to a fixed rule), BhP.; Pāṇ., Sch.; Kull.
legal decision or opinion (applied to the written extracts from the codes of law or adjustment of contradictory passages in different codes), W.
conviction, persuasion, R.
fixed relation of time or place, Pāṇ. i, 1, 34
rate, proportion, Bhpr.
state, condition, Kāv.; Rājat.
case, occasion, opportunity, Rājat.; W.
an engagement, agreement, contract, ib.
a: व्यवस्था — {c1c} A. 1 To be placed asunder. --2 To be arranged in due order. --3 To be settled or fixed, become permanent, वचतीयमिदं व्यवस्थितं Ku. 4. 21. --4 To rest or depend upon. --Caus. 1 To place or rest upon, direct towards; Ku. 7. 75. --2 To arrange, manage, adjust. --3 To settle, resolve, decree. --4 To separate, place apart. --5 To do, perform. --6 To lay down a rule or law, enact a law.

व्यवस्था — 1 Adjustment, arrangement, settlement; as in वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्था. --2 Fixity, definiteness; R. 7. 54. --3 Fixity, firm basis; आजहतुस्तच्चरणौ पृथिव्यां स्थलारविंदश्रियमव्यवस्थां Ku. 1. 33. --4 Relative position. --5 A settled rule, law, statute, decree, decision, legal opinion, written declaration of the law (especially on doubtful points or where contradictory texts have to be properly adjusted). --6 An agreement, a contract. --7 State, condition. --8 State or order of things. --9 Separation.

m: व्य्-अवस्था—दर्पण m. N. of wk.

s: puM, vizRuH । yaTA, -- “vyavasAyo vyavasTAnaH saMsTAnaH sTAnado DruvaH ॥” iti mahABArate tasya sahasranAmastotre । 13 । 149 । 55 ॥ (vi + ava + sTA + lyuw .) vyavasTitO, klI । yaTA, -- “cAturvvarRyavyavasTAnaM yasmin deSe na vidyate । taM mlecCadeSaM jAnIyAdAryyAvarttastataH param ॥” ityAryyAvarttaSabdawIkAyAM BarataH ॥
v: na॰ vi + ava + sTA--lyuw । 1 vyavasTAyAm । karttari lyu । 2 vizRO pu॰ vizRusa॰ ।

व्य्-˚अवस्थान n. steadiness, perseverance, continuance in (loc.), MBh.; R.
firmness, constancy, MBh.
state, condition (pl. ‘circumstances’), GopBr.; Rājat.
regular arrangement or distribution, MW.
a: व्यवस्थानं, व्यवस्थितिः — f. 1 Arrangement, settlement, determination, decision. --2 A rule, statute, decision. --3 Steadiness, constancy --4 Firmness, perseverance. --5 Separation. --नः N. of Viṣṇu.

m: व्य्-˚अवस्थान—प्रज्ञप्ति f. a partic. high number, Buddh.
व्य्-अवस्थापक mfn. (fr. Caus.) settling, arranging, deciding, establishing (-त्व n.), Hāsy.; Nyāyam., Sch.
a: व्यवस्थापक — a. (पिका f.) 1 Arranging, putting in proper order, adjusting, settling, establishing, deciding. --2 One who gives a legal opinion. --3 A manager (modern use).

m: व्य्-अवस्थापक—त्व n.
व्य्-अवस्थापक्˚अवस्थाप्य n. the state of being established &c., MW.
व्य्-˚अवस्थापनीय mfn. to be settled or established, Kull. on Mn. ix, 242.
व्य्-˚अवस्थापन n. supporting, encouraging, R.
fixing, establishing, deciding (also in law), Kām.; Kull.
a: व्यवस्थापनं — 1 Arranging, proper adjustment. --2 Fixing, determining, settling, deciding. --3 Fixing, placing (in general).

m: व्य्-अवस्था—पत्त्र n. a written deed, document, L.
व्य्-˚अवस्थापित mfn. arranged, settled, Kum.
caused to be placed or arranged, W.
a: व्यवस्थापित — p. p. Arranged, settled &c.; कथचिदद्रेस्ततया मिताक्षरं चिरव्यवस्थापितवागभाषत Ku. 5. 63.

m: व्य्-अवस्था—प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
व्य्-˚अवस्थाप्य mfn. to be established or declared (in each single case), Vop.
व्य्-अवस्˚थार्णव m. N. of wk.
व्य्-अवस्था—रत्न-माला f. N. of wk.
व्य्-अवस्था—सार-संचय m. N. of wk.
व्य्-अवस्˚था—सार-संग्रह m. N. of wk.
व्य्-अवस्था—सेतु m. N. of wk.
व्य्-˚अवस्थातृ mfn. one who settles or determines, Pañcar.
व्य्-अव˚स्थातिक्रम m. transgression or violation of the law or settled rule, breaking an agreement or contract, W.
व्य्-अव˚स्थातिवर्तन n. id., ib.
व्य्-अव˚स्थातिवर्तिन् mfn. transgressing the law, breaking an agreement or contract, ib.

s: tri, (vi + ava + sTA + ktaH .) viDipUrvvakasTitaH । vyavasTApitaH । yaTA, -- “aTa vyavasTitAn dfzwvA DArttarAzwrAn kapiDvajaH । pravftta SastrasampAte Danurudyamya pARqavaH ॥” iti SrIBagavadgItAyAm 1 aDyAyaH ॥
v: tri॰ vi + ava + sTA--kta । vizayAntaraparihAreRa vizayaviSeze avasTite 1 SAstravihite padArTe 2 avasTitamAtre ca ।
m: व्य्-अवस्थित mfn. placed in order, drawn up (in battle), Bhag.
placed, laid, put, stationed situated, standing or being in or on or at (loc. or comp.), Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
standing on the side of taking part with (comp.), Dhūrtas.
contained in (loc.), Sarvad.
used in the meaning of (loc.), signifying (as a word), Cat.
one who has waited or stayed, MBh.
based or dependent on (loc.), Kām.; Mālatīm. resolved upon (loc.), MBh.
persevering in, sticking or adhering to (loc. or comp.; with वाक्ये, ‘abiding in what is said’, ‘obeying’), Yājñ.; MBh. &c. intent upon, caring for (loc.), MBh.
settled, established, fixed, exactly determined, quite peculiar or restricted to (loc. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
constant, unchanging, Suśr.
existing, present, MBh.; Sarvad.
proving, turning out or appearing as (nom. or instr. or ind.p. or adv.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: व्यवस्थित — p. p. 1 Placed in order, adjusted, arranged. --2 Settled, fixed; किं व्यवस्थितविषयाः क्षात्रधर्माः U. 5. --3 Decided, determined, declared by law. --4 Stood aside, separated. --5 Extracted. --6 Based on, resting on. --Comp. --विभाषा a fixed option; व्यवस्थितविमाषया साधुः.

m: व्य्-अवस्थित—त्व n. continuance, permanence, duration, Suśr.

व्य्-अवस्थित—विकल्प m. (in law, gram. &c.) an option fixed or determined in each particular case applicable or omitted throughout (the operation being in one case carried out throughout and in the other omitted throughout), Dāyabh.; Kull.; APrāt.; Pāṇ., Sch.

constancy, steadfastness, Kathās.
fixity, fixed rule or statute, decision, determination, Mn.; Hariv. &c.
extracting (?), W.
a: व्यवस्थिति — See व्यवस्थान.

distributing, bestowing, Pāṇ. v, 4, 2
renunciation, resignation, L.
व्य्-˚अवसेय n. (impers.) it is to be settled or determined, Pat.

व्य्-अव-√ सृज् P. Ā. -सृजति, ˚ते, to throw, cast, hurl upon (gen.), MBh.; to put or lay down, ib.; to dismiss, send away, ŚBr.; to distribute, bestow (see व्य्-अवसर्ग), to hang on, fasten to (loc.), MBh. viii, 959 (prob. w.r. for व्यव-√ सञ्ज्).
व्य्-अव-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to creep or steal in AV.; TS.; Br.

s: tri, (vi + ava + so + ktaH .) pratAritaH । iti mUriprayogaH ॥ anuzWitaH । niScitaH । iti vyavasAyivyavasAyaSabdArTadarSanAt ॥ (yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 2 । 24 । 1 । “taM samIkzya vyavasitaM piturnirddeSapAlane । kOSalyA vAzpasaMrudDA vaco DarmmizWamabravIt ॥”)
m: व्य्-अवसित mfn. finished, ended, done, Kāṭh.
decided, determined, resolved, undertaken (also n. impers.; with dat. or inf.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
one who has resolved upon or is determined or willing to (loc., dat., or inf.), Kāv.; Pur.
settled, ascertained, known (n. impers.), convinced or sure of anything (with सम्यक्, ‘one who has ascertained what is right’; with acc., ‘one who has acknowledged anything as true’), MBh.; BhP.
deceived, tricked, cheated, disappointed, L.
energetic, persevering, making effort or exertion, W.
व्य्-अवसित n. resolution, determination, Kāv.; Pur.
an artifice, contrivance, Mṛcch.
a: व्यवसित — p. p. 1 Endeavoured, attempted; Ś. 6. 8. --2 Undertaken. --3 Resolved, determined settled. --4 Devised, planned. --5 Endeavouring, resolving. --6 Persevering, energetic. --7 Cheated, deceived. --तं Ascertainment, determination.

m: व्य्-˚अवसिति f. ascertainment, determination, resolution, Subh.

व्य्-अव-√ सो P. -स्यति (ep. also -स्यते [with act. and pass. meaning]; 1. sg. pr. -सामि; Pot. -सेयम्, -सेत्; fut. -सिष्यति), to settle down or dwell separately, ŚBr.; to differ (in opinion), contest, quarrel, ib.; to separate, divide (opp. to सम्-√ अस्), RPrāt.; to determine, resolve, decide, be willing to (acc. dat., अर्थम् ifc., or inf.), TBr. &c. &c.; to settle, ascertain, be convinced or persuaded of, take for (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to ponder, reflect, consider, MBh.; Śak.; to make strenuous effort, labour or seek after, make an attempt upon (acc.), MW. : Pass. -सीयते, to be settled or ascertained or fixed on or determined or decided (often impers.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -साययति, to cause to resolve, encourage to undertake, embolden, VS.; TS. ; to incite or instigate to (inf.), Kir.
a: व्यवसो — {c4c} P. 1 To strive, endeavour, try, seek, attempt, set about; ध्रुवं स नीलोत्पलपत्रधारया शमीलतां छेत्तुमृषिर्व्यवस्यति Ś. 1. 18; V. 4. --2 To think of, wish, desire; पातुं न प्रथमं व्यवस्यति जलं युष्मास्वपीतेषु या Ś. 4. 8. --3 To exert strenuously, be industrious or diligent. --4 To resolve, determine, settle, decide; Ś. 5. 19. --5 To accept, undertake; कच्चित्सौम्य व्यवसितमिदं बंधुकृत्यं त्वया मे Me. 114. --6 To be convinced or persuaded. --7 To reflect.

m: व्य्-अव-√ स्रंस् Ā. -स्रंसते, to fall asunder, TBr.
व्य्-अव-˚स्रंस m. See अ-व्य्˚.
व्य्-अव-√ स्रु P. -स्रवति, to flow or trickle asunder, dissolve, fail, come to nothing, MaitrS. : Caus. -स्रावयति, to cause to flow asunder &c., Kāṭh.
व्य्-अवस्त mfn. = व्य्-अवसित, Divyāv.
bound (?), ĀśvŚr. (Sch.)
व्य्-अव-√ स्तृ to spread out below, ĀpGṛ.
व्य्-अव-√ स्तुभ् P. -स्तोभति, to interpose certain sounds or interjections in chanting the Sāma-veda, Lāṭy.
व्य्-अव-तिष्ठमान See व्यव-√ स्था.
व्य्-अवतिष्ठमान mfn. standing apart, W.
व्य्-अव-√ वद् P. Ā. -वदति, ˚ते, to speak ill of, decry, PañcavBr.; to begin to speak, break silence, ChUp. (Śaṃk.)
व्य्-अव-˚वद्य mfn. to be spoken ill of or decried, PañcavBr.
व्य्-अव-√ विद् P. -वेत्ति, to discern, discriminate, ŚBr.
व्य्-अव-√ व्ली P. -व्लिनाति, to sink down, collapse, MaitrS.
व्य्-अवे (-अव-√ इ) P. -अवौति, to go or pass between, separate, ŚBr.; Kauś.; (in gram.) to resolve or separate by inserting a vowel, Prāt.; to dissolve, decompose, MW.
a: व्यवे — {c2c} P. 1 To divide, separate. --2 To dissolve, decompose.

m: व्य्-˚अवेधातृ mfn. one who separates or interposes or screens, MW.
व्य्-अवेत mfn. separated, divided (esp. by insertion of a letter), Prāt.; Pāṇ. (-त्व n.)
a: व्यवेत — p. p. 1 Separated, decomposed. --2 Different.

m: व्य्-अवेत—त्व n.
1. व्यय् cl. 1. P. Ā. व्ययति, ˚ते (rather Nom. fr. व्यय below), to expend, spend, waste, Bhaṭṭ.; Hit.; Subh.; cl. 10. P. व्यययति id., Dhātup. xxxv, 78; to go, move, ib.
2. व्यय् (v.l. for व्यप्) cl. 10. P. व्याययति, to throw, Dhātup. xxxii, 95.
a: व्यय् — {vI.v} {c10c} U. (व्यययति-ते) 1 To go, move. --2 To expend, give away, bestow. {vII.v} {c1c} U. (व्ययति-ते) To go, move. {vIII.v} {c10c} U. (व्याययति-ते, also व्यापयति-ते) 1 To throw, cast. --2 To drive.

s: [n] tri, (vyayo'syAstIti । vyaya + iniH .) vyayayuktaH । yaTA, -- “draviRaM parimitamaDikavyayinaM janamAkulIkurute । kzIRAYcalamiva pInastanajaGanAyAH kulInAyAH ॥” ityudBawaH ॥
m: व्ययी in comp. for व्यय.
व्ययी—भूत mfn. spent, squandered, wasted, W.
व्ययी—करण n. the act of expending or disbursing, wasting, W.
व्ययी—√ कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, to waste, expend, Kathās.
व्ययी—कृत mfn. expended, spent, lavished, Kām.; Rājat.

Ya gatO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰uBa॰-saka॰-sew .) Ya, vyayati vyayate । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

m: व्यय mfn. (or व्य्-अय, fr. 3. वि + √ 5. इ) passing away, mutable, liable to change or decay (only as opp. to or connected with अ-व्यय), Mn.; MBh.; Pur.
व्यय m. (ifc. f(आ). ) disappearance, decay, ruin, loss, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

व्यय m. spending, expense, outlay, disbursement (opp. to आय, ‘income’, and often with कोशस्य, वित्तस्य, धनस्य &c.; without a gen. = ‘extravagance, waste, prodigality’; with loc. or ifc. = ‘outlay for or in’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
cost, sacrifice of (gen. or comp.; व्ययेन ifc. = ‘at the cost of’), R.; Kālid.
wealth, money, Yājñ. ii, 276
(in gram.) inflection, declension, Nir.
N. of the 20th (or 54th) year of Jupiter's cycle, VarBṛS. of a serpent-demon, MBh.
of Pradhāna, MW.
व्यय m. or n. = -गृह, VarBṛS.
a: व्यय — a. Liable to change, mutable, perishable; cf. अव्यय. --यः 1 (a) Loss, disappearance, destruction; आपाद्यते न व्ययमंतरायैः कच्चिन्महर्षेस्त्रविधं तपस्पत् R. 5. 5, 12. 23. (b) Cost, sacrifice; प्राणव्ययेनापि मया विधेयः Māl. 4. 5. Ku. 3. 23. --2 Hindrance, obstacle; भूयस्तपोव्ययो मा भूत् R. 15. 37. --3 Decay, decline, overthrow, downfall. --4 Expenditure, expense, outlay, spending, applying to use (opp. आय); आये दुःख व्यये दुःख धिगर्थाः कष्टसंश्रयाः Pt. 1. 163; आयधिकं व्ययं करोति ‘he lives beyond his means’; R. 5. 12, 15. 3; Ms. 9. 11. --5 Extravagance, prodigality. --Comp. --पर a. lavish in expenditure; Pt. 5. 61. --पराङ्मुख a. stingy, niggardly. --शील a. spendthrift, prodigal. --शुद्धिः f. {{derfraying->defraying||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}} of expenses.

k.v: अभिहारोऽभिग्रहणं निहारोऽभ्यवकर्षणम्. अनुहारोऽनुकारः स्यादर्थस्यापगमे व्ययः॥

m: व्यय—भवन n. = -गृह, VarBṛS.
व्यय—शालिन् (Rājat.) mfn. disposed to prodigality, wasteful, spendthrift.
व्यय—शील (Kāv.) mfn. disposed to prodigality, wasteful, spendthrift.
व्यय—गत mfn. (v.l. for next).
व्यय—गृह n. (in astron.) N. of the 12th house from the Lagna, VarBṛS.
व्यय—गुण mfn. prodigal, spendthrift, one who spends all his money, impoverished, MBh.
व्ययक mfn. expending, making payments, Kām.
व्यय—कर mf(ई)n. one who makes payments, Kām.
व्यय—करण or व्यय—करणक, m. a paymaster, Pañcad.
व्यय—कर्मन् n. the business of a paymaster, Yājñ.; R.
व्ययमान mfn. expending, wasting, W.
व्ययन n. going apart, separation, RV.
a: व्ययनं — 1 Spending. --2 Wasting, destroying.

m: व्यय—पराङ्मुख mf(ई)n. averse from expenditure, parsimonious, Yājñ. i, 83.
व्यय—स्थान n. = -गृह, Cat.
व्यय—सह mfn. ‘bearing waste’, inexhaustible (as a treasure), Kām.
व्यय—सहिष्णु mfn. bearing loss of money patiently, ib.
व्यय—वत् mfn. liable to change, not complete, RPrāt.
spending much, prodigal, Yājñ.
inflected, VPrāt.
व्ययि in comp. for व्ययिन्.
व्ययिन् mfn. declining, decaying, falling (in उदय-व्य्˚, ‘rising and falling’), Hit.
expending, spending, prodigal (in बहु-व्य्˚, q.v.)
व्ययि—ता f.

s: tri, (vyaya + ktaH .) kftavyayaH । vyayaSabdAditapratyayena vyayaDAtoH ktapratyayena vA nizpannam ॥
m: व्ययित mfn. expended, spent, dissipated, dispersed, Hit.
gone away, declined, fallen into decay, W.
a: व्ययित — p. p. 1 Expended, spent. --2 Wasted, fallen into decay.

m: व्ययितव्य mfn. to be expended or spent, Camp.
व्ययि—त्व n. prodigality, wastefulness, MW.
व्यष्ठ n. copper, L.
व्य्—अष्टका f. the first day in the dark half of a month, TS.; TBr.; Kāṭh.; Lāṭy.
the dark half of a month, ĀpGṛ. (Sch.)
व्यष्ट˚का f. See p. 1028, col. 3.
व्यष्टक n. (v.l. for मुष्ठक, q.v.) black mustard, L.
व्य्-अष्टि f. attainment, success, TS.; ŚBr. &c.

(in Vedānta) singleness, individuality, a separated aggregate (such as man, viewed as a part of a whole [e.g. of the Universal Soul] while himself composed of individual parts; opp. to सम्-अष्टि, q.v.), Śaṃk.; Vedāntas.
व्य्-अष्टि m. N. of a preceptor, ŚBr.
a: व्यष्टि — f. 1 Individuality, singleness. --2 Distributive pervasion. --3 (In Vedānta phil.) An aggregate or whole viewed as made up of many separate bodies (opp. समष्टि q. v.).

m: व्य्-अष्टि—समष्टि-ता f. the state of individuality and totality, Vedāntas.
व्य्-अष्˚ट्य्-अभिप्राय m. regarding (a group of objects) singly or individually, MW.
